Job Title:

Sr. Software Architect (NiCE CXone & Cognigy)

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Concentrix is seeking a Sr. Software Architect (NiCE CXone & Cognigy) to lead the design, implementation, integration, and evolution of enterprise customer experience solutions.

This is a senior customer-facing technical leadership role responsible for architecting and delivering scalable NiCE CXone and Cognigy solutions across complex enterprise environments. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong consulting, delivery, and problem-solving skills to help clients modernize their customer engagement platforms.

You will work directly with clients, business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, AI-enabled customer experience solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions utilizing NiCE CXone, Cognigy, and related enterprise technologies.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide direction on critical technical decisions.
  • Establish architecture standards, implementation patterns, and technical best practices.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities across applications, integrations, infrastructure, and data platforms.

Implementation & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of NiCE CXone and Cognigy solutions from discovery through production deployment.
  • Design and oversee integrations with CRM, telephony, workforce engagement, AI, data, and enterprise platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and performance issues.
  • Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, availability, maintainability, and supportability.

Hands-On Development

  • Configure and implement NiCE CXone platform capabilities.
  • Design, develop, and deploy Cognigy conversational AI applications, workflows, and integrations.
  • Build reusable accelerators, integration patterns, and technical assets that improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
  • Support testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational readiness activities.

Consulting & Collaboration

  • Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to define solution strategies, technical roadmaps, and implementation plans.
  • Partner with sales, solutioning, and delivery teams on client pursuits, technical workshops, architecture assessments, and implementation planning.
  • Mentor architects, engineers, and technical consultants.
  • Contribute to technical estimates, solution design, and architecture discussions for strategic initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in customer experience technologies, CCaaS solution architecture, software engineering, systems integration, or enterprise technology delivery.
  • Hands-on implementation experience with NiCE CXone.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or integrating conversational AI solutions, AI agents, virtual assistants, generative AI technologies, or enterprise automation platforms, including Cognigy or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, CRM, workforce management, cloud platforms, security, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience leading complex technical implementations and multi-disciplinary delivery teams.
  • Strong communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strongly Preferred

  • NICE CXone Certified Implementation Professional (CIP) certification or equivalent NICE implementation credentials.
  • NICE CXone implementation certifications in ACD/IVR, AI Routing, Digital Experience, Agent Embedded/Integrated, or related CXone modules.
  • NICE Certified Implementation Engineer (NCIE) certifications in Interaction Analytics, Workforce Management, Quality Management, Performance Management, or related NICE solutions
  • Cognigy Associate, Engineer, Conversation Design, or related Cognigy certifications.
  • Experience with Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow, or related customer engagement platforms.
  • AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline.

Why Join Concentrix?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and deliver next-generation customer experience solutions at global scale. You will work across NiCE CXone, Cognigy, AI, automation, cloud, and customer engagement technologies while helping some of the world's leading brands modernize their customer experience ecosystems.

You'll have the opportunity to influence architecture standards, accelerate AI adoption, and help define how global organizations leverage CCaaS, conversational AI, and intelligent automation to transform customer experiences.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with clients, and balancing architecture leadership with hands-on delivery, you'll thrive in this role.

The base salary for this position is $122,001- $191,715 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is: 09/10/2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

As part of the hiring process, candidates may be required to undergo background screening and identity verification, where permitted by applicable law and consistent with the requirements of the role. Certain verification processes used by the Company or its service providers may involve technologies that rely on biometric identifiers or biometric information, where permitted by law. If biometric identifiers or biometric information are collected, used, or stored, the Company will provide the legally required disclosures and obtain any required written consent prior to such collection, and will handle such information in accordance with applicable biometric privacy laws and Company policies.

raw.description:
The Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure to take the lead in designing, optimizing, securing, and ensuring the reliability of our cloud infrastructure. In this role, you'll be responsible for the management and optimization of our CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure automation, security posture, performance monitoring, and cost efficiency across Azure. You'll take operational ownership, including responding to Azure alerts, proactively improving performance, and maintaining a robust security framework for our Azure environment.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the Philippines.

Key Responsibilities

Automation & CI/CD

  • Automate the build, test, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning pipelines using Azure DevOps, Bicep/ARM, or Terraform.

  • Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines integrated with GitHub or Azure Repos.

  • Enhance deployment reliability and speed by applying automation best practices.

Azure Infrastructure Management

  • Design, maintain, and optimize secure, scalable Azure infrastructure (e.g., App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Key Vault, Azure Monitor).

  • Manage networking, identity, and access controls using Azure best practices (Azure AD, RBAC, NSGs, VNets).

  • Own the performance and health of Azure resources across various environments (dev, staging, production).

  • Continuously improve cost efficiency and performance using Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor, and right-sizing strategies.

Monitoring, Alerts & Reliability

  • Implement end-to-end monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.

  • Actively monitor and respond to Azure alerts, incidents, and performance issues.

  • Proactively manage server and application performance (CPU, memory, scaling, latency, throughput).

  • Ensure high availability, backup, and disaster recovery strategies are in place and regularly tested.

  • Lead root cause analysis and drive improvements to prevent recurring issues.

Security & Compliance

  • Continuously improve Azure Secure Score and implement security best practices across environments.

  • Address Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations to strengthen security posture.

  • Enforce security practices (e.g., least privilege, secret management, patching, vulnerability remediation).

  • Collaborate with engineering to ensure secure cloud-native architecture patterns.

Quality & Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering and QA teams to support release automation and ensure environment stability.

  • Participate in system architecture discussions and performance tuning of infrastructure.

  • Document infrastructure standards, runbooks, and operational procedures to ensure consistency.

What Were Looking For

Must-Have Technical Skills

  • 7+ years of DevOps/SRE experience, with at least 3+ years focused on Microsoft Azure.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates).

  • Hands-on experience managing production Azure environments.

  • Proficient in scripting languages like PowerShell, Python, or Bash.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AKS).

  • Experience with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps Pipelines or GitHub Actions.

  • Deep knowledge of Azure monitoring, alerting, cost optimization, and security services.

  • Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and cloud security best practices.

DevOps & SaaS Mindset

  • Strong understanding of SaaS uptime, reliability, and scalability needs.

  • Experience managing production systems with incident response ownership.

  • Proactive approach to automation, observability, cost control, and security improvements.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

  • Strong analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to problem-solving.

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote and distributed team.

  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability in your work.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionQuantum Sky is searching for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to build and enhance cloud-based and on-premise cybersecurity and compliance applications for highly regulated environments.
raw.description:
Description

Quantum Sky is searching for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to build and enhance cloud-based and on-premise cybersecurity and compliance applications for highly regulated environments. This is a hands-on development role

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with experience developing applications in FISMA/FedRAMP environments and familiarity with NIST security and compliance frameworks. They are comfortable owning software across the full development lifecycle—from design and development through CI/CD, deployment, and production operations—and can effectively work across software development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance.

This role includes work on data-intensive risk and compliance analytics products: applications that ingest security and inventory data from multiple, heterogeneous, and sometimes inconsistent sources, normalize it into a consistent internal model, and present risk, gap, and prioritization analytics to different classes of users (executive, program-management, and technical).

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack application capabilities with an emphasis on secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and supporting tools.
  • Build new product capabilities and enhance existing functionality across cloud-based/on-premise cybersecurity and compliance applications, including backend services and user-facing application features.
  • Design and implement integrations with cloud services, security technologies, vulnerability management platforms, monitoring solutions, and third-party systems using REST APIs and structured.
  • Develop capabilities that ingest, process, correlate, and present security and compliance information while automating workflows such as security monitoring, vulnerability management, evidence collection, control management, and reporting.
  • Design data models and normalization/correlation logic capable of reconciling overlapping or conflicting records from multiple independent data sources into a single, consistent, and traceable representation, preserving source provenance and confidence.
  • Design and implement configurable scoring, prioritization, or risk-analytics logic as discrete, testable components rather than embedded business rules — supporting features such as gap analysis, trend analysis, and what-if/scenario comparison.
  • Model relationships and dependencies between assets, systems, and organizational entities in a way that supports drill-down analysis and can scale toward graph-based or dependency-graph representations as products mature.
  • Implement role-based access control and role-differentiated views so that different user types (executive, program/system management, technical) see appropriately scoped and appropriately detailed information.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes that support application builds, automated testing, security validation, and reliable deployment across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Build, deploy, and support containerized and cloud-native applications, collaborating with cloud and DevOps engineers to improve application scalability, reliability, observability, security, and performance.
  • Use AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies as part of day-to-day engineering workflows to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, and code analysis.
  • Apply engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code and recommendations, validating outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, deployment, and production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including architecture and design discussions, code reviews, testing, documentation, release management, deployment, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Apply secure software development and DevSecOps practices throughout the application lifecycle and collaborate with cybersecurity and compliance subject matter experts to translate security and domain requirements into practical software capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Demonstrated professional experience designing, developing, and supporting production software applications.
  • Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating applications with external systems and services.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, backend application architecture, and modern front-end web development technologies — including designing schemas for data that is multi-source, or evolving, not just well-specified from the outset.
  • Experience modeling and querying hierarchical or graph-like relationship data.
  • Experience working within a CI/CD and DevOps-based software delivery environment, including automated builds, testing, deployments, version control, and release processes.
  • Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, using technologies to support repeatable and automated deployments. Experience with Docker, containers, or other managed container platforms
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies as part of day-to-day professional software development.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot software, integration, deployment, and production issues and develop secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across software engineering, product, cloud, cybersecurity, and compliance teams.
  • Comfort operating in a high-ambiguity, early-stage product environment: able to ask clarifying questions, propose trade-offs, and iterate without fully specified requirements.
  • Experience working with Modular Open Systems Architecture relying largely on open-source technology

Desired:

  • Experience developing software for cybersecurity, cloud security, GRC, compliance, or continuous monitoring use cases.
  • Experience building data ingestion, correlation, or entity-resolution logic that reconciles records from multiple independent tools or data sources.
  • Experience building scoring, prioritization, ranking, or recommendation engines as reusable, configurable components.
  • Exposure to graph databases (e.g., Neo4j or Postgres-native graph extensions like Apache AGE) or graph/network analysis libraries (e.g., NetworkX) — relevant to dependency- and relationship-modeling features.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable DevOps automation technologies.
  • Experience with advanced AI-assisted or agentic software engineering workflows, including AI-driven testing and validation, code analysis, workflow automation, or agent orchestration.
  • Knowledge of the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53 Revision 5, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), FedRAMP, and FISMA security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience translating cybersecurity or regulatory requirements into application features, automation, workflows, integrations, or reporting capabilities.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management, POA&M management, security controls, evidence collection, and continuous monitoring concepts.
  • Familiarity with cryptographic concepts (e.g., PKI, certificates, key management, cryptographic algorithms and protocols) sufficient to work productively with subject-matter experts.
  • Experience integrating applications with security tools, cloud APIs, vulnerability scanners, SIEM platforms, asset inventorying or other cybersecurity technologies such as Tychon, Tenable, ServiceNow, etc...
  • Experience developing and operating software supporting federal government, enterprise, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Software development experience with Python or professional experience developing applications using Django or Go (Golang) and familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or other modern application development languages.

Clearance:

  • US Citizenship with the ability to obtain a security clearance
  • DOD/DoW Secret or Top Secret clearance is preferred

Location:

  • Remote, US with 10% travel as needed

About Quantum Sky

Compensation:

  • Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $165,000-$200,000. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.

Benefits:

  • Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave.

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

raw.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary: Sr. Director Product Management AI Experiences

In this vital leadership role, you will serve as the Senior Director of Product Management for AI Experiences, acting as the single-threaded technical product leader responsible for transforming Vivint’s smart home hardware into a proactive, intelligent ecosystem. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will serve as the organization's independent strategic engine for software intelligence. You will bridge the gap between complex machine learning architectures and delightful consumer interfaces, defining the experiences that allow the future home to work seamlessly on behalf of our customers—giving back time, keeping them safe, and saving them money.

This role requires a forward-looking product leader with a deep technical understanding of where AI and machine learning are going. You will be responsible for defining a multi-year vision and building "new-to-world" experiences that utilize ambient intelligence, predictive analytics, and computer vision across our entire hardware portfolio. You will lead a team of Technical Product Managers and collaborate with AI data scientists, platform engineers, and hardware architects to turn raw ambient telemetry into deeply personalized, high-value consumer offers.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic AI Vision & 3-Year Roadmap

  • Next-Gen Experience Strategy: Own the definition, multi-year sequencing, and execution of the AI experience roadmap across the entire Vivint and NRG smart home portfolio.
  • Predictive Futures: Develop a comprehensive 3-year product roadmap rooted in a deep technical understanding of emerging AI/ML capabilities, translating future technological vectors into immediate, high-value customer benefits.
  • New-to-World Innovation: Autonomously identify, scope, and validate "white space" opportunities to deploy net-new, disruptive AI experiences that shift the smart home from a reactive state to an ambient, proactive state.

Ecosystem Intelligence & Technical Execution

  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Serve as the strategic thought leader on how disparate hardware endpoints (cameras, panels, sensors) and cloud platforms can leverage unified machine learning models to act as a singular, cohesive system.
  • Technical Deep-Dives: Author high-quality, data-driven narrative documents (PRFAQs, Working-Backwards documents, and 3-Year Operating Plans) to align senior executive leadership (VP+) on high-stakes AI investments, algorithm training requirements, and data privacy policies.
  • Data & AI Mechanisms: Define and scale cross-organizational mechanisms to continuously monitor model performance, customer usage telemetry, and behavioral data to rigorously refine and iterate on shipped experiences.

Leadership, Influence & Team Coaching

  • Team Management: Directly manage, mentor, and scale a lean team of high-performing Technical Product Managers, fostering a deep culture of technical excellence, algorithmic rigor, and extreme customer-centricity.
  • Matrixed Influence: Operate independently to influence, unblock, and align a highly cross-functional, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Data Science, AI/ML Platform Engineering, UX Design Language teams, and Hardware Product lines.
  • Execution Excellence: Translate complex machine learning capabilities into precise, unambiguous product requirement documents (PRDs), ensuring a reliable and ethical path from initial model training to mass-market production deployment.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous AI Strategy: Proven ability to define long-term product frameworks and navigate intense ambiguity independently. You must be comfortable establishing a product path where technical baselines or data sets are completely undefined.
  • AI/ML Product Mastery: Deep technical literacy in applying machine learning approaches to consumer-facing ecosystems. Direct experience productizing capabilities like computer vision, edge-AI processing, natural language processing, or predictive behavioral modeling is required.
  • Ecosystem & Hardware Familiarity: Strong understanding of how software intelligence interacts with physical consumer hardware lifecycles, including ambient wireless frameworks, cloud latency constraints, and local device processing limitations.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Narrative Writing: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven track record of presenting complex data science and product concepts clearly to non-technical executive leadership to secure broad organizational alignment.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated specifically to shipping consumer-facing AI/ML software features, intelligent IoT experiences, or complex data-driven platforms at scale.
  • Technical Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience managing products that require close, daily coordination with AI data scientists, machine learning infrastructure engineers, and data privacy teams.
  • Leadership Track Record: 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing technical product professionals, with a proven ability to scale a team's technical capacity.
  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in a Technical Field (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline); MBA or equivalent business experience preferred.

raw.description:
At xneelo, it starts with purpose. We’re business enablers offering a hosting service for our customers to create and transact online. We spend each day working hard to retain the trust of our customers. Inspired by our brand promise ‘trusted in hosting’, we deliver a web hosting service that is reliable and consistent, focusing on infrastructure stability, good value and consistent service delivery.

A large scale, mass-market hosting infrastructure is a complex beast requiring quality automation and processes to make sure it can scale and perform optimally, 24x7x365.

Product development at xneelo looks to the engineering of the backend infrastructure as a vital component of being able to delight our customers - by being part of transforming complexity into click-of-a-button simplicity.

We are passionate about frequent, iterative delivery of high-quality software and aim to build lasting solutions using Agile principles and the latest technology available.

We work together in autonomous teams that take full responsibility for their own part of the xneelo ecosystem and require an understanding of the Agile development philosophy.

Like what you hear? Well, let’s break it down:

Basically, you will be involved in

  • Full-stack development with a passion for end-to-end development and ownership across the stack, with a particular interest and strength in front-end development.

  • Solving interesting and large-scale backend technical challenges

  • Being part of figuring out how we get better at what we do

  • Looking for opportunities to innovate and optimize

  • Understanding the needs of the customer in order to deliver innovative, robust solutions (In collaboration with the Product Owner and stakeholders, of course)

  • Supporting the customer from an operational perspective when escalated by the Client Services team

You probably have a passion for

  • Programming, open-source technologies, and IT in general

  • Optimal systems and simple procedures

  • Agile development and a self-organizing team environment

  • Sharing ideas and innovation

Requirements

You have a passion for

  • Design & development of backend software and APIs

  • Front-end development (React, Angular or Vue)

  • Object-oriented programming using a language like Ruby

We are seeking a Senior Cardiologist to provide scientific and medical leadership across cardiac safety, cardiac efficacy, and digital physiology solutions. In this highly visible role, you will partner with pharmaceutical sponsors, contribute to regulatory strategy, advance innovative endpoint development, and serve as a trusted cardiology expert internally and externally. Your expertise will help drive high-quality clinical research, support regulatory decision-making, and accelerate the development of therapies that improve patients' lives worldwide.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned to the U.S. market

  • Comprehensive health, retirement, and wellness benefits

  • Opportunities to work on global, high‑impact clinical programs

  • Collaboration with leading scientists, clinicians, and technologists

  • Ongoing professional development and research engagement

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Represent Clario by providing cardiology expertise to pharmaceutical sponsors across consulting services, including protocol design and development, cardiac safety and efficacy strategies, statistical analysis plans, expert report writing, and regulatory representation

  • Serve as a cardiology liaison across internal departments, supporting cardiologist activities, cardiac solutions, safety consulting, and cardiac‑related compliance strategies

  • Support clinical consulting for Digital Physiology and other Clario endpoints, enabling cross‑business‑unit opportunities and therapeutic area strategies

  • Participate in client discussions for prospective and ongoing studies requiring cardiac safety or efficacy approaches

  • Assist Cardiac Solutions Scientific and Medical Affairs leadership in developing, maintaining, and updating policies, procedures, and SOPs, including Cardiology Review Guidelines and expanded digital physiology endpoints

  • Stay current on scientific advancements in cardiac safety and efficacy and educate internal stakeholders as appropriate

  • Support generation of endpoint data through interpretation of ECGs, Holters, patch devices, stress tests, blood pressure variability assessments, and related endpoints, including QA and QC activities

  • Contribute to ECG core lab procedures to enhance interpretation quality, consistency, and operational efficiency

  • Provide sales support by contributing scientific and clinical expertise as needed

  • Support system development and validation efforts for EXPERT and other Clario platforms

  • Participate in meetings and research collaborations with regulatory authorities

  • Provide leadership in statistical innovation and research, supporting sponsor interactions involving statistical design and analysis and contributing strategically across Clario lines of business.

What We Look For

  • MD degree required

  • ABIM Board Certification

  • Board certification in Cardiovascular Diseases required for U.S.‑based candidates

  • Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology training preferred

  • Minimum of three years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry as an employed cardiologist or consultant, particularly in early‑phase development

  • Five or more years of clinical cardiology and electrocardiography experience preferred

  • Experience with concentration‑effect modeling and strong familiarity with ICH E14 guidance preferred

  • Experience authoring reports for QT waivers and working knowledge of clinical pharmacology desirable

  • Prior experience working with or consulting for pharmaceutical sponsors

  • Demonstrated high ethical standards and commitment to representing Clario with integrity and professionalism.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Guidewire Developer to deliver configuration, integration, and customization across the Guidewire InsuranceSuite — PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter — and Guidewire Cloud. The role focuses on hands-on Gosu development, integration design, product model configuration, and Guidewire Cloud upgrades, working closely with business analysts and SMEs to ship reliable insurance-platform features. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Guidewire work in production for insurance carriers and understands the trade-offs that come with deep platform customization. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop configuration and customizations across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter using Gosu.
  • Implement product model changes including coverages, conditions, and term-level logic.
  • Build and maintain Guidewire integrations using messaging, batch, plugins, and Guidewire Integration Gateway.
  • Develop integrations with policy, claims, billing, document generation, payment, and reinsurance systems.
  • Implement rules using GX Model, business rules, and validation rules.
  • Support Guidewire Cloud Platform upgrades, configuration refactoring, and adoption of cloud-native patterns.
  • Develop and maintain unit tests, regression suites, and automated testing for Guidewire components.
  • Build PCF (Page Configuration File) customizations following Guidewire best practices.
  • Implement Guidewire entity model extensions, augmentations, and data model changes following platform-supported patterns that remain compatible with future Cloud Platform upgrades.
  • Profile and optimize performance of complex Gosu logic and database queries, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to standards, and document technical decisions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across the InsuranceSuite footprint — PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter — applying systematic diagnostics and partnering with insurance SMEs to drive durable resolutions.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and SMEs on requirements clarification.
  • Stay current with Guidewire releases, Cloud Platform evolution, and insurance domain trends.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of Guidewire development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Gosu programming and Guidewire data model.
  • Hands-on experience with PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter customization.
  • Strong understanding of product model and rule design.
  • Experience building Guidewire integrations (messaging, batch, plugin).
  • Familiarity with Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of Guidewire database schema.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Guidewire ACE certifications.
  • Experience with Guidewire Cloud upgrades.
  • Familiarity with Guidewire Digital portals or DataHub/InfoCenter.
  • Insurance domain expertise across P&C lines.
  • Experience with reinsurance, policy administration, or claims modernization programs.

raw.description:
Compensation: $130,000–$150,000 base + $130,000–$150,000 variable (OTE $260,000–$300,000)

About the Role

DomainTools is looking for an experienced Expansion Sales Manager to accelerate growth within our existing customer base. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, responsible for managing a defined book of business and achieving expansion revenue targets through product upgrades, increased consumption, additional use cases, new departments, and broader enterprise deployments.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished enterprise sales professional with a proven track record of expanding complex technology accounts and building trusted relationships with executive, business, and technical stakeholders at some of the world’s largest organizations.

The Expansion Sales Manager will own the full expansion sales process within assigned accounts—from identifying and qualifying opportunities through developing business cases, negotiating commercial terms, and closing business. The role will also help customers realize continued value from DomainTools solutions by maintaining consistent engagement and aligning our capabilities to their evolving cybersecurity priorities.

This role requires close partnership across New Logo Sales, Renewal Sales, Sales Engineering, Sales Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Partner Alliances,Product and our Executive Team.. Strong cross-functional influence and orchestration are essential to success.

The successful candidate will combine strategic account planning, operational rigor, executive presence, consultative selling skills, and a customer-first approach to deliver consistent expansion growth and predictable business results.

Key Responsibilities

Expansion Revenue and Account Ownership

  • Own the expansion revenue target and sales quota for an assigned book of existing DomainTools customers.
  • Identify, develop, and close expansion opportunities across product upgrades, increased consumption, additional use cases, new departments, new business units, and broader enterprise deployments.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that prioritize the highest-potential growth opportunities within the assigned book of business.
  • Manage the complete expansion sales process from prospecting and discovery through opportunity qualification, business case development, negotiation, and close.
  • Generate and maintain sufficient pipeline coverage to support current and future expansion revenue objectives.
  • Apply repeatable sales strategies and methodologies to produce predictable expansion bookings.
  • Meet or exceed assigned sales targets and role-specific KPIs.
  • Maintain ownership and accountability for the progression, accuracy, and outcome of expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to participate and travel to required conferences and customer events.

Strategic Account Growth

  • Develop trusted-advisor relationships with key customer stakeholders, executive sponsors, technical leaders, procurement teams, and business decision-makers.
  • Build relationships beyond existing customer champions by identifying additional stakeholders, departments, business units, and use cases within strategic accounts.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of each customer’s cybersecurity environment, organizational priorities, business drivers, technical requirements, and purchasing processes.
  • Communicate the business and technical value of DomainTools and its role within the customer’s broader security architecture.
  • Conduct effective discovery to identify customer challenges, desired outcomes, decision criteria, competitive considerations, and opportunities for expansion.
  • Build compelling business cases that clearly articulate customer outcomes, value realization, competitive differentiation, and justification for additional investment.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering and customer stakeholders to define positive business and technical outcomes for expansion opportunities.
  • Develop account strategies that support long-term customer growth rather than transactional selling.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures and sales cycles across large multinational enterprises and government organizations.

Customer Engagement and Value Realization

  • Maintain consistent engagement with assigned customers throughout the year to understand evolving business priorities, technical needs, and expansion potential.
  • Lead and participate in quarterly business reviews, product roadmap discussions, feature-release updates, consumption reviews, and strategic account planning sessions.
  • Maintain visibility into customer adoption, consumption, use cases, satisfaction, and overall account health to identify both growth opportunities and potential risks.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Account Management, Renewal Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure customers realize the expected value from their DomainTools solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to increase product adoption and expand the use of DomainTools across additional teams and workflows.
  • Support seamless customer transitions and handoffs across New Logo, Expansion, and Renewal Sales motions.
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally by communicating customer requirements, product feedback, emerging use cases, competitive intelligence, and market trends.
  • Partner with Renewal Sales to maintain strong customer relationships and support successful, on-time renewals.
  • Proactively address customer concerns and coordinate internal resources to maintain customer confidence and momentum.

Pipeline, Forecasting, and Operational Excellence

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management, opportunity qualification, and forecasting discipline across the assigned book of business.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and predictable forecasts to sales leadership.
  • Maintain complete and accurate customer, pipeline, opportunity, account health, and forecasting data in Salesforce, Gainsight, and other designated systems.
  • Monitor pipeline quality, quantity, velocity, conversion, and coverage and take corrective action when performance falls below expectations.
  • Consistently execute against forecasted commitments and clearly communicate changes that could affect expected business results.
  • Keep sales leadership informed of significant opportunities, customer risks, competitive developments, and other factors that may affect expansion revenue.
  • Use customer, product-consumption, and pipeline data to prioritize accounts and identify expansion opportunities.
  • Follow DomainTools’ sales methodology, qualification standards, opportunity-management requirements, and forecasting processes.
  • Maintain strong documentation of customer interactions, next steps, decision criteria, stakeholders, and mutual action plans.
  • Demonstrate accountability for assigned goals, customer engagement expectations, and business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with New Logo Sales and Renewal Sales to create a seamless customer lifecycle and maintain clearly defined ownership across sales motions.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop technical strategies, demonstrate solution value, validate use cases, and define successful customer outcomes.
  • Work with Customer Success and Account Management to understand customer adoption, consumption, satisfaction, and potential areas for growth.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify and execute customer expansion campaigns, programs, events, and targeted account initiatives.
  • Partner with Partner Alliances and channel teams to identify opportunities for joint account development and expansion.
  • Collaborate with Product to communicate customer feedback, emerging requirements, competitive intelligence, and opportunities for additional use cases.
  • Work closely with Sales Operations and sales leadership to maintain effective territory planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and performance measurement.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support complex customer opportunities and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience.
  • Represent DomainTools at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and company events as required.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused go-to-market culture.

Requirements

  • Sales Experience & Impact: 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales or strategic account management experience, with a proven track record of exceeding quotas and closing six-figure expansion deals within Global/Fortune 100 organizations.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape (Threat Intelligence, DNS, or Internet infrastructure) and the business drivers influencing enterprise security investments.
  • Strategic Methodology: Expert application of consultative sales frameworks (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Challenger) to conduct discovery, build ROI-based business cases, and navigate complex multinational sales cycles.
  • Executive Engagement: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence C-level executives and technical stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Operational Rigor: Strong analytical approach to territory planning, pipeline management, and forecasting using Salesforce and Gainsight.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams (SE, CS, Marketing, Product) and work autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; willingness to travel for customer engagement.
  • Ability to Travel: Easy access to Seattle, Southern California, Chicago or Boston airports.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Meet or exceed assigned expansion bookings and quota targets.
  • Generate and maintain healthy, predictable expansion pipeline coverage.
  • Increase the adoption, consumption, and penetration of DomainTools solutions across assigned accounts.
  • Expand relationships into additional departments, business units, use cases, and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify and close larger, more strategic expansion transactions.
  • Improve pipeline conversion, opportunity velocity, and forecast accuracy.
  • Develop compelling business cases that connect DomainTools capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.
  • Maintain consistent customer engagement and support long-term retention.
  • Establish trusted relationships with executive, technical, procurement, and business stakeholders.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and maintain strong CRM and opportunity-management discipline.
  • Independently manage a complex book of business while effectively coordinating internal resources.
  • Collaborate across the go-to-market organization to maximize customer value and expansion revenue.

Benefits

DomainTools is the global leader for Internet intelligence and the first place security practitioners go when they need to know. The world’s most advanced security teams use our solutions to identify external risks, investigate threats, and proactively protect their organizations in a constantly evolving threat landscape. DomainTools constantly monitors the Internet and brings together the most comprehensive and trusted domain website and DNS data to provide immediate context and machine-learning driven risk analytics delivered in near real-time.

DomainTools offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees that includes fully paid medical, dental and vision insurance premiums, a 401k retirement plan with company matching, basic life insurance, flexible PTO and additional well-being benefits.

DomainTools embraces diversity, equity and inclusion to its fullest as an equal opportunity employer. We build our teams so creativity and innovation can flourish. We believe inclusivity and equity fosters innovation and growth, and we harness this mindset to drive a culture that serves our employees and our customers. We encourage people of all backgrounds, ages, perspectives and skill sets to apply; and do not discriminate based on age, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

The main function of a Benefits Analyst is to manage benefit-related data and compliance processes, including performing various audits in Workday to ensure data integrity and running reports to update information. This role serves as lead for Retro deduction processes. Additionally, the Analyst guides the global benefits team in administering Qualified Life Events (QLE) and new hire changes, ensuring timely responses to benefits inquiries from colleagues, managers, or HR via Zendesk, and auditing and updating Workday benefits and demographic data. ​

  • Data Management & Auditing: Provides guidance and works closely with the global benefits team to manage data within Workday, performing various audits to ensure accuracy and running reports to update data as needed.

Required Experience:

raw.description:
Who are we?

HubSpot is a leading customer platform that brings marketing, sales, service, and operations tools together to help businesses attract, engage, and delight customers. It's our mission to not just help them grow, but to help them grow better. Our global team builds with heart, curiosity, and a drive to solve for the customer while doing work that matters.

We value flexibility, autonomy, and results over where you’re located. This role is open to remote workers anywhere in Australia, with our ANZ office based in Sydney’s CBD.

What’s the role?

Senior Customer Success Managers (CSMs) at HubSpot are trusted strategic advisors responsible for driving customer retention and expansion across a portfolio of higher-value Mid-Market and Corporate accounts. You'll own around 140 complex accounts, leading strategic conversations, strengthening discovery and value realisation, and ensuring customers achieve measurable ROI, adopt HubSpot deeply, and see long-term success with our platform.

You'll use data, AI, and HubSpot's Customer Prioritisation Framework (CPF) to engage the right customers at the right time - driving both Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Gross Expansion Rate (GER).

As a Senior CSM in the Corporate team, you will:

  • Own customer growth, retention, health and delight across a portfolio of higher-value customers.
  • Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders across customer teams.
  • Lead strong discovery and strategy conversations to understand customer goals, risks, priorities and opportunities.
  • Define what success looks like for your customers and build clear success plans that connect HubSpot usage to measurable business outcomes.
  • Monitor customer health, identify risks early and create clear mitigation plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer adoption and usage of relevant HubSpot products.
  • Partner closely with Contract Management, Sales, Solutions Architects, Support and other cross-functional teams to support renewals, adoption and customer outcomes.
  • Provide clear forecasting insight around upcoming renewals and customer risk.
  • Use data, AI and Success Excellence metrics to prioritise effectively, consult at scale and improve customer impact.
  • Share learnings and best practices with the team to improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of how we support customers.
  • Embody HubSpot’s Culture Commitments by solving for the customer, being bold and learning fast, aligning/adapting/going, and delivering with HEART.

Who are you?

  • Extensive experience in owning, maintaining, and driving customer relationships in a quota or retention-carrying role.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding retention or revenue goals in a SaaS or Customer Success role.
  • Comfortable adopting new technologies quickly, with experience leveraging AI tools and predictive insights to scale your impact.
  • Strong discovery and business acumen — able to ask thoughtful questions, uncover customer priorities, diagnose problems and recommend commercially sound next steps.
  • Comfortable managing complex, higher-value or multi-stakeholder accounts.
  • Clear written and verbal communicator, including confidence leading strategic conversations via Zoom, phone and email.

We prioritize learning and teamwork and love giving people the opportunity to champion solutions to big challenges and grow into better versions of themselves. A great candidate believes in Raya's vision, which is to enrich lives by fostering relationships through quality, in person interactions. You thrive at the intersection of quality and shipping, and you're excited to build the release systems, quality gates, and testing strategy that let Raya ship a consumer app our members trust every time.

Responsibilities

  • Quality Strategy: Own the QA strategy across automated and manual testing, deciding what we automate, what we test by hand, and what we accept as risk, with regression coverage on critical paths like onboarding, payments, subscriptions, messaging, and login, including where third-party testing services and AI-assisted QA tooling fit in.

  • Visibility and Communication: Maintain the release calendar and Quality scorecards including report crash rates, defect escape rates, and release health to leadership

  • Continuous Improvement: Run release retros, turn incidents and escaped defects into durable process fixes, and connect release decisions to the incident response process

  • Release Ownership: Run the release process end-to-end for the Raya iOS app from predictable release trains with clear cut, freeze, and submission dates through App Store submission, phased rollout, and rollback/fix forward

  • Go/No-Go Process: Define release readiness criteria, lead go/no-go decision making

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in software quality, release management, or engineering, with 3+ years managing people

  • Deep knowledge of the App Store release lifecycle: TestFlight, phased release, expedited review, and rejection handling

  • Experience with subscription and payment flows on iOS

  • Experience building test automation strategy for mobile, including real-device testing, feature flags, and progressive rollouts

  • Experience deciding the split between automated and manual testing, and managing third-party QA or crowdtesting vendors

  • Fluency with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, and strong knowledge of Git branching strategies for mobile release workflows

  • Clear, direct written communication

What Sets You Apart

  • Systems Builder: You build process and automation, so release quality depends on systems rather than memory

  • Impact-driven: You focus regression and automation coverage on the paths that matter most to members, rather than chasing full coverage everywhere

  • Ownership mentality: You take escaped defects from discovery to root cause to prevention

  • Bridge Builder: You partner with engineering managers, product, and leadership, embedding quality into everyday workflows while balancing team velocity

  • Bias toward shipping and iteration: You improve the release process incrementally in short cycles rather than waiting for a perfect system

raw.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Memphis
raw.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
raw.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

Fleet Support Manager

Location: Remote

Contract: Fixed-term maternity cover until October 2027

Are you highly organised, analytical and confident working with data? We’re looking for a Fleet Support Manager to join us on a fixed-term basis, providing maternity cover until October 2027.

Working closely with the Head of Fleet Development and the wider Fleet team, you’ll play an important role in turning fleet data into meaningful insight. You’ll manage and analyse information from Fleetwave, suppliers and other data sources, producing reports that help us understand performance, costs and opportunities across the fleet.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll support a varied range of fleet activity, including managing the vehicle movement process and maintaining accurate asset information; producing fleet reports, datasets and management information; monitoring supplier performance, KPIs and pricing; and helping identify opportunities to improve fleet utilisation and replacement planning.

You’ll also become a key user of Fleetwave, supporting reporting, compliance and trend analysis, while contributing to fleet procurement projects, tender documentation, business cases and the vehicle ordering process.

This is a role with plenty of variety and exposure across the business, working with Fleet, Finance, operational teams, suppliers and other key stakeholders.

What we’re looking for

You’ll be comfortable working with systems, data and reports and have strong attention to detail. You’ll need good MS Office skills, particularly Excel, alongside previous experience of system administration, data management, reporting and data analysis.

You’ll be someone who can manage your own workload, communicate confidently with people at different levels and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Experience within the waste industry, transport or logistics, B2B service delivery or management systems such as ISO would be advantageous, but isn’t essential.

Biffa – we’re changing the way people think about waste

At Biffa, we love working with waste. Whether we’re turning it into sustainable power, finding new ways to recycle it or simply keeping it off the streets, we believe every day is an opportunity to improve the lives of millions. It’s a view that’s shared by our 11,000+ people around the country, who trust us to provide them with a career that’s always rewarding, often challenging, but never dull.

We believe different ideas, perspective and backgrounds are key to developing a creative and effective working environment which is why you’ll find us championing diversity and equality at every turn.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Business Unit leaders, and external agency partners, you will be responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads, accelerate pipeline growth, and contribute directly to revenue targets.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and performance optimisation. You will play a critical role in translating go-to-market strategies into measurable marketing programs while ensuring leads are effectively nurtured, managed, and converted through the funnel.
The successful candidate will bring strong experience in activation strategy, marketing automation, campaign management, lead lifecycle management, and multi-channel campaign execution.

Demand Generation & Pipeline Growth

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Coordinate campaign assets, messaging, and activation plans across multiple stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with external agency to execute paid media, trade media, digital advertising, and lead generation programs.
  • Partner with the Events team to support a global calendar of trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry events.
Marketing Automation & Lead Management

  • Use Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement) to create and manage email campaigns, engagement studio nurture programs, automated lead workflows and segmentation.
Performance Measurement & Optimisation
  • Track, analyse, and monitor key metrics including MQL generation, lead-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline contribution and campaign ROI.
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.
  • Establish testing frameworks for continuous optimisation of messaging, channels, and audience targeting.
Qualifications & Experience
Required
  • 3+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Demand Generation or Digital Marketing within a B2B environment.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce campaign management and reporting.
  • Strong experience using Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), including Engagement Studio and automation workflows.

  • Analytical skills with experience interpreting campaign and funnel performance data.
  • Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within a matrixed, global organisation.
Desirable
  • Experience marketing SaaS, technology, regulatory, data, or digital solutions.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units or product portfolios.
  • Experience with Google Analytics, WordPress, and AI-enabled marketing tools and technologies.

Occasional travel may be required to support business meetings, tradeshows, customer events, and team collaboration activities.
