raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As a Manager of Solutions Engineering for Majors at Grafana Labs, you will be responsible for all aspects of building and managing a team of high-performing Solution Engineers. You will own the regional build-out with your sales leader counterparts, adopting existing OSS Specific GTM strategies and developing new ones as needed. You’ll work with your Customer Experience counterparts to ensure that your customers are successful after the sale, in their adoption and roll-out of Grafana products through professional services, support, training, and customer success. You’ll work with marketing to drive community and adoption programs in the region designed to broaden the adoption of both OSS and commercial/cloud versions of our products. You’ll also work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that we are constantly delivering value to our customers by influencing the roadmap, based on your customers and team feedback, as well as leveraging your own experience in the Monitoring and Observability space. All of this will be required for you to hit and then exceed your region's financial targets and ultimately, our company's goals. Your impact will be felt globally when the job is done well.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Attract, recruit, ramp, and mentor a team of great Presales SE’s from diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • Get the best out of your team with a coaching mindset and lead from the front approach. Adopting a player/coach mentality will be critical here, ensuring that you balance your field responsibilities with the needs of your team.
  • This role requires you to lead from the front! Executive sponsorship of key accounts in the region will be key to your success. The right candidate will be a thought leader to customers and internally within Grafana Labs.
  • Direct the bulk of your day-to-day work based on guidance and goals from your leadership, owning the planning, actions and outcomes of the region.
  • Partner with Sales leadership on top of funnel programs, marketing initiatives and community/company events to drive awareness of Grafana’s brand and the problems we help solve.
  • Understanding your key customers’ strategies for adoption of Grafana technologies and developing programs and collateral to enable them to be successful.
  • Ensure that your customers’ requirements are being met with our product through partnership with Product Management and Engineering
  • Own and report on the quarter over quarter cadence of your team while they help prospects evaluate our software with discovery, demonstrations, key stakeholder interviews, workshops and technical validation, including POVs and Mutual Account Plans
  • Own your teams PG plan in partnership with your sales and sales leader counterparts, helping build pipeline for new logo targets

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Located in the US
  • 5+ years in the high tech industry having held roles such as Developer, Sales Engineer/Architect, Manager, etc.
  • Direct experience mentoring, developing people and managing performance over time.
  • Experience in Open Source selling or Cloud first/Product led sales go to market motion a big plus.
  • Direct experience implementing and/or executing a formal sales methodology, Command of the Message, qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC.
  • Direct experience selling monitoring/data/visualization products.
  • Direct experience in DevOps (IaC, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, etc) a plus
  • Proven ability to own a book of business, direct your own and your team's work and initiatives to exceed your quarterly targets.
  • Proven ability to work with sales leader counterparts

Compensation & Rewards

In the US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $234,000 - $278,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

The Vice President - People & Culture serves as the senior-most HR leader for the organization, responsible for building and executing a global people strategy that aligns with business priorities and supports a consistent, high-quality employee experience across all regions.

This role unifies multiple HR functions - including HR Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition support for Corporate Functions, HR Operations and Administration, Employee Support Services, Benefits, Compensation, and close collaboration with Payroll operated under Financial Operations - into a cohesive, scalable, and service-focused People & Culture function.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Enterprise People Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute a global People & Culture strategy aligned with organizational objectives and executive leadership priorities.

Total Rewards & Compensation

  • Partner with Finance on workforce budgeting, forecasting, and workforce cost planning.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Establish and maintain a robust people governance framework that ensures compliance with employment legislation, regulatory requirements, company policies, and ethical standards globally.

People Analytics, Technology & Team Leadership

  • Leverage people analytics and workforce insights to support strategic decision-making, workforce planning, and organizational performance.
  • Oversee the effective use and continuous improvement of HR technologies and people systems, maintaining strong governance over workforce data quality, privacy, and compliance.

The Vice President - People & Culture will lead a team including Senior HR Business Partners, Senior Manager - Benefits & Compensation, and Manager - People & Culture Operations, providing guidance, performance leadership, and growth opportunities to develop a high-performing organization.

Position Requirements

  • Masters’ or international equivalent in Business, Human Resources or similar field required.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of progressive HR leadership experience with at least 5 years leading multiple global/international HR functions
  • Proven Success leading HR in global, multi-region organizations of similar scale (1,500-5,000 employees).
  • Experience guiding organizations through transition, restructuring or HR transformation.
  • Deep knowledge of global employment practices, compliance, HR Operations and modern talent strategies.

Exposure:

  • Background in professional services, technology, shared services or other global, matrixed environments.

Script Writer & Editor

Remote · Part-time or Full-time · YouTube Entertainment

About List25

List25 is one of YouTube's longest-running list-style channels, entertaining millions of viewers with fast-paced, fact-packed videos. We cover everything from history and science to pop culture and the bizarre — and we're growing fast. We need a sharp writer who can keep audiences glued from the first second to the very last frame.

The Role

You'll own the words that drive our videos. That means researching topics, writing punchy scripts, and editing them until every sentence earns its place. You understand YouTube's attention economy and know how to engineer a hook that makes people stick around — and come back.

What You'll Do

  • Write and edit engaging scripts for list-style YouTube videos (800–5,000 words)
  • Craft irresistible intros that hook viewers in the first 30 seconds
  • Structure scripts to maximize audience retention throughout the video
  • Research topics and fact-check content for accuracy
  • Collaborate with our production team on titles, thumbnails, and pacing notes
  • Revise scripts based on performance data — you're always learning what works

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience writing scripts for YouTube — please include channel links or samples
  • A master of the hook: your intros make people forget they were about to scroll away
  • Deep understanding of retention — you think in loops, payoffs, and pattern interrupts
  • Fast, clean writer who can hit a deadline without sacrificing quality
  • A sharp editor — you cut ruthlessly and every word has a reason to be there
  • Bonus: familiarity with List25's style, or experience in the list/trivia genre

Nice to Have

  • Experience analyzing YouTube analytics to improve future scripts
  • Background in journalism, copywriting, or broadcast writing
  • Passion for trivia, history, science, or pop culture

We're the team iGaming operators turn to when growth matters most — and we're growing fast ourselves. At Receptional, you'll find colleagues who are bright, ambitious, and genuinely supportive. We were named Marketing Services Supplier of the Year at the EGR B2B Awards 2026, and Best Medium Agency to Work For at the Company Culture Awards 2025 — recognition for the work we do and the place we've built to do it.

Paid search in iGaming demands a level of precision and compliance awareness you won't find in most agency environments. The budgets are significant, the regulatory requirements are strict, and clients expect a manager who can own their accounts with genuine autonomy — not someone who needs constant oversight.

As a Paid Search Manager at Receptional you'll be running Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns across a portfolio of iGaming clients, owning compliance for your accounts, managing up to two direct reports, and working closely with the Senior Paid Search Manager on strategy and client development. It's a specialist role with real ownership, clear progression, and the kind of technically demanding work that keeps experienced paid search professionals genuinely engaged.

What We're Looking For


You'll need to be a strong practitioner who can operate with genuine autonomy — someone who owns their accounts, spots issues before clients do, and brings strategic thinking to every campaign they touch. iGaming adds a compliance layer that not every paid search professional has experience with, but if you're thorough, detail-oriented, and take regulatory standards seriously, we'll get you up to speed. You'll also be managing direct reports, so clear direction, honest feedback, and genuine investment in people development comes with the territory.

Essential:
  • 3+ years' experience in Paid Search advertising, preferably agency-side
  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads — Search, Display, and Performance Max
  • Google Ads certified — current and maintained
  • Ability to manage client relationships independently — you prepare and deliver presentations with confidence
  • Good campaign planning capabilities — budgeting, forecasting, and performance management across multiple accounts
  • Willingness to line manage and develop junior team members
  • Able to work autonomously and manage competing priorities without things slipping
  • Numerate and analytically strong with clear verbal and written communication skills

What You'll Be Doing


This is a specialist paid search role with real autonomy and line management responsibility. raw.description:
Our merchants are the heart and soul of our business, and the Merchant Success Team at Loop exists to optimize the value of the Loop partnership to their business. This begins with the merchant onboarding experience and continues through ongoing support and strategic account management.

As an Enterprise Merchant Success Manager at Loop, you will serve as the strategic advisor to our larger, more complex merchant relationships. Through business acumen, empathy, strong communication, and cross-functional leadership, you will work with our merchants to achieve measurable outcomes, deepen their partnership with Loop, and build durable, long-term relationships.

This role requires the ability to navigate sophisticated organizations, align executive and operational stakeholders, translate complex data into a clear value story, and mobilize the right Loop resources based on merchant needs and business impact.

Right away, we’ve listed what we think you’ll be spending your time on. We’re growing fast, and growth means the challenges we’ll work on together will change as we lead Loop through new and different phases.

This is an indispensable role with us, so we’ll be looking for you to have examples of when you’ve tackled these challenges throughout your career. We’ve laid out the experience we think is important to set you up for success in this role. But, we appreciate that different humans will solve problems in different ways, so we don’t expect you to fit exactly in a box of requirements.

At Loop, we're intentional about how we work so everyone can do their best work. We call this our Blended Working Environment. Our team is based across our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, as well as Hub and Secluded locations through the United States, select Canadian provinces, the United Kingdom, and select Australian states.

For this position, we are looking for a teammate located in the United States.

Challenge: Be accountable for revenue retention and expansion goals for Loop’s enterprise merchants.

  • Your main priority is to make our merchants successful, and you’ll use any and all of your resources to make it happen.

  • Be accountable for revenue retention, renewals, expansion, and retraction mitigation across your assigned portfolio.

  • Develop strategic account plans that connect each merchant's priorities to measurable business outcomes, product adoption, renewal strategy, and long-term growth opportunities.

  • Identify risks early, create clear mitigation plans, and maintain accurate forecasts and internal visibility throughout the merchant lifecycle.

  • Lead complex renewal and commercial conversations, clearly articulating Loop's value and competitive differentiation to stakeholders across the merchant's organization.

  • Work in close partnership with Sales to uncover cross-sell opportunities, build business cases, and convert them into closed revenue.

Your Experience:

  • You have +3 years customer success or account management experience with enterprise businesses for B2B SaaS products. If you have experience working with the ecommerce industry, that is a huge differentiator for us!

  • You’ve managed accounts for a long enough period of time that you oversaw the renewal process with them, and have successfully renewed many enterprise accounts.

  • You know what it’s like to be accountable for revenue goals, and you’ve accomplished (or exceeded!) them in the past.

  • You have tried and true ways to uncover and close new opportunities with accounts, and are willing to share a few examples with us.

  • You can speak to how you use tools, including AI, to improve how you work, scale your impact, and better support enterprise merchants.

Challenge: Accelerate customer adoption by developing and strengthening exceptional relationships with your accounts.

  • Lead quarterly business reviews and executive touch points that connect Loop performance to merchants goals, demonstrates measurable value, and establish clear recommendations and next steps.

  • Engage in regular, creative touchpoints with your accounts to get in front of any issues prior to renewal and avoid merchant churn.

  • Increase the usage and adoption of all Loop’s features by communicating new feature updates to your accounts, focusing on the value they’ll provide to that specific merchant.

  • Build credibility with senior and executive stakeholders while maintaining strong relationships with day-to-day partners and operational teams.

  • Make Loop better by talking to merchants constantly and reporting product enhancement themes and feedback to the rest of the Merchant Success team.

Your Experience:

  • You’ve been involved in merchant communications in prior roles, either owning 100% of your communications or partnering with marketing teams to strategically generate messaging.

  • You love data and are highly proficient with spreadsheets, using them to extract, analyze, and interpret insights that power compelling value stories for your customers.

  • You have examples of how your proactive interactions and strong relationships with customers have directly contributed to mitigating churn, and have increased usage of product features.

  • Creating exceptional partnerships with your merchants and becoming one of their favorite people to work with are always top priorities for you.

  • You can share a couple of examples of how you’ve thoughtfully shared customer feedback that led to updates to your product.

  • You understand the different stages of the customer journey, and that there’s a difference in how they should be communicated with.

Challenge: Lead cross-functional outcomes for complex merchant needs.

  • Orchestrate the right partnership across Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, Support, Data, and leadership to advance high-impact merchant outcomes.

  • Lead high-stakes escalations with clear ownership, disciplined communication, realistic expectations, and a focus on rebuilding or strengthening merchant confidence.

  • Represent recurring enterprise themes and opportunities to Product and leadership, helping Loop stay close to the problems our merchants need us to solve.

Your Experience:

  • You have led cross-functional work without direct authority and know how to create clarity, accountability, and momentum across teams.

  • You remain composed and credible through ambiguity, service issues, competing priorities, and executive-level escalations.

  • You can share examples of customer feedback that influenced product, process, or service improvements while maintaining appropriate expectations.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

About the Team 

The Research Department atCollegeBoard is a dynamic and influential team, consisting of highly skilled professionals, dedicated to building outstanding tools to support the critical, mission-driven work ofCollegeBoard. Through rigorous and innovative research, our team ensures thatourprogramsand services are grounded in robust data and sound methodologies.Ourworknot only supports the development of high-quality assessments and educational resources but also drives the organization’s mission to connect students tocollegesuccess and opportunity. The team's impact is far-reaching, enhancingthe educationalexperiences and outcomes for millions of students nationwide. 

About the Opportunity  

As a ResearchStatistician Ion our Advanced Placement Psychometric team, you will play a vital role in both operational and research psychometric work. This position offers you the chance to innovate and discover new or improved methods to enhance our processes. You will engage in both individual and collaborative efforts with your team members and the broader organization, focusing on operational data and statistical analyses, research discovery, documentation, procedures, reporting projects, and research initiatives. Join us to make a significant impact on our mission and advance your career in a supportive learning environment.

In this role, you will:

Statistical Analysis (30%)

  • Support operational work by performing standardized analyses

  • Support statistical analyses using large-scale internal data

  • Produce standard tables and graphical displays of large-scale statistical results

  • Produce data aggregations (descriptive statistics, correlation coefficients)

  • Write basic queries, programs, and generate reportsrepresentinga variety of formats

  • Work with a variety of data filesrepresentingitem-, student-, school-, district-, institution-, state- and national-levels

Data Manipulation (30%)

  • Help organize data into a variety of formats topermitfor use in specialized statistical software used for research or psychometric work

  • Manipulate output from statistical analysis for use in statistical analyses

Quality Management (30%)

  • Create andmaintaindataset documentation and layouts

  • Implement QC procedures on all statistical analyses

  • Identifyingand implementingthe qualitychecks and validations for critical business process changes/impacts.

  • Performing detailed review of project deliverables/outputs such as process documents, publications,requirementsetc.

Research (10%)

  • Support the fulfillment of large-scale, strategically important research and analysis projects

  • Undertake research and analysis projects as secondary investigator

  • Implement QC procedures on all statistical analyses

  • Provide personalized datarepresentinga variety of data sources (internal) to research scientists and psychometricians. These data include student performance, meta data, standards, student overall test scores, school/district/institutiondataand related attributes

  • Provide research support and guidance to colleagues 

 About You 

You have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, social science, math/sciencefieldor equivalent experience

  • One to three years ofdemonstratedproficiencywith statistical analysis programing (SAS, R, or Python preferred)

  • Experience handling and manipulating large-scale data

  • Experience with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Outlook), with an emphasis on MS Word and Excel

  • Strong organization, prioritization, and multitasking skills, both independently and as the member of a team   

  • Adept problem-solving skills, including using data to inform decisions and actions   

  • Proficiencyin developing and implementing analytical models with complex data

  • Research skills andexpertiseinmethodology

  • Ability to translate general inquiries into analysis questions and tasks

  • Organizational and time management skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Keen attention to detail

  • Ability to function in a team-oriented unit

  • You mustbe authorized towork in the US

About Our Process 

  • Application review will beginimmediatelyand will continue until the position isfilled

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generallyincludes:resume and application submission, recruiter phone screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise and/or panel interview, and reference checks. This isapproximatelyan8- to12-weekprocess

CollegeBoard offers a competitive benefits and compensation program that attracts top talent looking to make a difference in education. As a self-sustaining non-profit, we believe in compensating employees equitably in relation to each other, their qualifications, their impact, and the relevant market.

The hiring range for a new employee in this position is $56,000to $100,000.CollegeBoard differentiates salaries by location so where you live will narrow theportionof this range in which you can expect a salary.

Your salary will be carefullydeterminedbased on your location, relevant experience, the external labor market, and the pay of College Board employees in similar roles.CollegeBoard strives to provide our best offer up front based onthese criteria.

Your salary is only one part of all that College Board offers, including but not limited to:

  • A comprehensive package designed to support the well-being of employees and their families and promote education. Our robust benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, fertility benefits, pet insurance, tuitionassistance, retirement benefits, andmore

  • Recognition of exceptional performance through annual bonuses, salary growth over time through market increases, and opportunities for merit raises and promotions based on increased scope ofresponsibility

You can expect to have transparent conversations about benefits and compensation with our recruiters throughout your application process.

About Our Culture 

Our community matters, and we strive to practice and improve our culture daily. Here are some headlines:

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.

raw.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of the payments platform and experiences that help drive the accelerated growth we’ve experienced across our Grading and Marketplace business lines, including our Liquidity offerings and Digital Repacking product (Power Packs).

Money movement sits underneath nearly everything Collectors does. Every grading submission, vault transaction, marketplace sale, consignment payout, among other transactional experiences relies on a payment stack that has to be fast, resilient, cost-effective and compliant across a growing number of business models and expanding globally. This role will own that stack outright: how funds come in, how funds go out, how they are routed and how customers see and control their money in our products.

You will work with stakeholders across our Marketplace and Grading business lines, Finance and Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk, as well as other Product and Tech partner teams, with regular exposure to the executive team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the payments strategy and roadmap. Set a multi-year direction for the payment platform that serves today's revenue lines and anticipates the ones we haven't launched yet. Sequence platform investment against near-term business commitments and defend those tradeoffs with executives.

  • Build a wallet that customers can use across our products and platforms. Own balance and activity views, top-up, withdrawal, and split-pay, turning stored value from a settlement mechanism into a reason customers choose us.

  • Take payments international. Deliver the payment, currency, and local method capabilities, partnering with Tax and Legal on registration, reporting obligations including DAC7, and market-by-market compliance.

  • Run money-in and money-out end to end. Acquiring, alternative payment methods, payouts, settlement, funding patterns, and reconciliation, including the ledger and reporting foundation Finance depends on for accurate, timely close.

  • Drive orchestration and cost optimization. Own multi-PSP routing, least-cost routing, failover and redundancy, retry and decline strategy, and network-level economics. Treat authorization rate and cost per transaction as products you are accountable for, not metrics you report on.

  • Partner internally with Risk and Fraud teams to reduce payment fraud and dispute loss, transaction screening, chargeback and dispute workflows, and the approval-rate-versus-loss tradeoff.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in product management, with deep payments or consumer fintech experience. You have owned production payment systems at meaningful scale, not adjacent surfaces. Senior IC experience at a high-growth marketplace, fintech, or platform company is preferable.

  • Fluent in the payments stack. Card networks and interchange, gateway and PSP integrations (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, or comparable), tokenization, 3DS and SCA, alternative and local payment methods, payouts, and dispute lifecycles. You know where the money and the failure modes actually live.

  • Experienced in cross-border payments. You have launched payments into new countries and navigated currency, local methods, and regulatory and tax reporting requirements with Legal and Compliance partners.

  • Experience with a marketplace, where pricing, promotions, and payment mechanics all pull on the same supply-and-demand levers.

  • Rigorous and decisive under ambiguity. You use data and experimentation where they apply, make high-conviction calls where they don't, and take full accountability for the outcome.

  • A clear communicator who builds alignment without authority. You compress complexity for executives and hold the line on detail with the teams building it.

  • Nice to have: Strong on financial operations. You have built or materially improved ledger, settlement, and reconciliation systems, and you have worked shoulder to shoulder with Accounting through close.

Salary Range: The salary range for this position is $190,000 – $300,000. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.

Reasons To Join Us:

  • Health Insurance:All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • Additional Benefits:Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits.

  • 401(K) Matching Plan:We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals

  • Vacation:All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off.

  • Holiday Pay:All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays

  • Employee Discounts:Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions

  • Flexible Hours:Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs

  • Fun Working Environment:Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities


Collectors uses e-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States.


We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to .

We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.

raw.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

The Site Care Partner is a crucial liaison for investigative sites throughout a study's lifecycle, responsible for site start-up, activation, relationship management, recruitment, and quality assurance. This role also contributes to site selection, provides local intelligence, ensures site support, resolves issues, and collaborates with various functions to optimize communication, maintain site quality and patient safety utilizing data analytics to identify and mitigate risks. The Site Care Partner may be expected to support Country Specific Activities that are required to ensure end-to-end clinical trial implementation (start up to close out).

Key Accountabilities:

Site start-up and activation

  • Deploys client site strategies by qualifying and activating assigned sites

  • Supports processes to optimize country & site selection activities including review and assessment of the draft potential site list and provide site qualification output for site selection

  • Supports the Feasibility Strategy and Analytics Lead to ensure that high quality feasibility results are delivered

  • Collaborates with key stakeholders providing country/regional level input to country outreach surveys including protocol feasibility, country Standard of Care (SOC) and medical practices (as applicable) under supervision.

  • Provide country/regional level input to country strategy, feasibility and protocol design in collaboration with relevant Medical Affairs colleagues, and with input from external clinical experts as required.

  • Maintains a knowledge of assigned protocols

  • Conducts study start-up activities at the site level including but not limited to Site Qualification, coordination of site activation checklist items, Informed Consent Form (ICF) finalization, Site Initiation Visit (SIV) as applicable, including management of issues that may compromise time to site activation.

  • Ensures all the site initiation activity including training per site activation checklist, collect and / complete necessary documentation/ systems needed for site activation

  • Supports country specific ICF review and deployment up to Site Activation

  • Ensures follow up activities’ completion post Site Qualification visit and SIV to ensure site readiness for First Subject First Visit (FSFV)

  • Partners with Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to ensure site monitoring readiness in anticipation of FSFV

  • Responsible for relationship building and operational quality of the site

  • Provides study support on escalated site issues related to study delivery by coordinating communications and resolution efforts. (e.g., vendor, site contracts and payment issues etc.)

  • Ensures the strategy and approach for Investigational Product (IP) and ancillary supplies for sites and country requirement throughout the lifecycle of the study

  • Accountable for effective site recruitment planning and delivery, consistent with global and/or country plan and local targets; Jointly responsible with CRA for enrollment delivery during study conduct

  • Partners with local Regulatory authorities and Study Start up teams to ensure timely completion on country / local registry up to Site Activation

  • Responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with Site Organizations and Strategic Partners

Intelligence gathering

  • Provides input into country strategy/planning and site recommendations via intimate understanding of country/region, sites, processes and practices, and associated site performance metrics

  • Provide input to cluster level intelligence for site strategy and support implementation of cluster-level strategy in collaboration with study management

  • Provide regional exploration/territory development growing adjacent opportunities where possible

  • Provides support to study management to define local requirements for the importation/exportation processes of the investigational medical product and ancillary supplies

Study conduct and close-out

  • Reviews Site Reports and related issues

  • During the conduct of the study, the Site Management Organization Assessment is reviewed with the site, when applicable, on an annual basis following site initiation and updated as needed. In addition, the Site Management Organization (SMO) Assessment is reviewed and updated when major staffing, contracting, or other significant site changes/issues occur to confirm that continuity and contingency plans are current

  • Informs and educates investigator sites of client pipeline opportunities that may be a good fit

  • Supports development and delivery including issue resolution of decentralized capabilities at investigator sites

  • Demonstrates leadership within the local clinical development environment with a goal to enhance client reputation in scientific leadership

  • May act as a Subject Matter Expert on client systems and processes.

  • Actively pursues possible efficiencies and develop best practices in the delivery of activities for site performance throughout the life cycle to increase investigator/site satisfaction and strengthen site relationships

  • Ensures clear and open communication with the study team

  • Supports the CRA to develop positive Investigator relationships throughout the life of the study and escalate any training or compliance concerns with Study Management

Compliance with Parexel standards

  • Complies with required training curriculum

  • Completes timesheets accurately as required

  • Submits expense reports as required

  • Updates CV as required

  • Maintains a working knowledge of and complies with Parexel processes, ICH-GCPs and other applicable requirements

Skills:

  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to manage required travel

  • Demonstrated networking and relationship building skills

  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross functional relationships

  • Ability to communicate effectively and appropriately with internal & external stakeholders

  • Ability to adapt to changing technologies and processes

  • Knowledge of country requirements for GCP that may be different to those of client procedures

  • Effectively overcoming barriers encountered during the implementation of new processes and systems

  • Identifies and builds effective relationships with investigator site staff and other stakeholders

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization

  • Effective in managing cross functional relationships

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience in site management with 5+ years prior experience as a CRA in a clinical research or pharma organization

  • Oncology monitoring/CRA experience is preferred

  • Experience reviewing monitoring reports is required

  • Demonstrated experience in start-up activities through site activation

  • Demonstrated experience in conduct and close out activities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of quality and regulatory requirements in applicable countries

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience (at least 5 years’ experience)

  • Proficiency in local language preferred. English is required

EEO Disclaimer
Parexel is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected status, which in the US includes race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

At Smart Working, we believe the right job should do more than strengthen your CV — it should challenge you, inspire you, and feel right every day. We connect experienced professionals with long-term, full-time remote roles where engineering excellence truly matters.
Our mission is to remove geographic barriers and match top talent with global teams building high-impact, mission-critical products. We partner with companies that value precision, ownership, and long-term growth, empowering our people to thrive both professionally and personally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to work in a truly remote-first environment.

About the Role

Important: Laravel-only experience is not qualifying — proven Symfony experience is mandatory!!!
We’re hiring a Senior Symfony Engineer to work on mission-critical backend systems where code quality, reliability, and accountability are non-negotiable. This role goes far beyond feature delivery, it’s about engineering craftsmanship, technical ownership, and building systems you can truly stand behind.
You’ll be part of a highly collaborative Agile team, working closely with product, QA, and other engineers across the full lifecycle — from ticket definition and design through testing, review, and production deployment. This role is ideal for someone who values clean architecture, Test-Driven Development, thoughtful technical decisions, and mentoring others while building robust, scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality backend systems using PHP and Symfony
  • Own features end-to-end, from ticket creation and technical design to production release
  • Write clean, strongly-typed, maintainable, and testable code that meets strict quality standards
  • Apply design patterns thoughtfully and consistently
  • Build and maintain comprehensive automated test coverage using PHPUnit and similar tools
  • Follow and promote Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices
  • Use static analysis, linters, and code quality tools to ensure reliability and consistency
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and QA teams to deliver robust solutions
  • Break down complex initiatives into well-defined, actionable tasks and guide implementation
  • Monitor systems and participate in a rotating on-call schedule when required
  • Promote secure coding practices and ensure code is free from known vulnerabilities
  • Document architecture, decisions, and processes to support team-wide knowledge sharing
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience with PHP (7.4 / 8+)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the Symfony framework
  • Strong understanding and practical use of design patterns
  • Solid experience with unit and integration testing (PHPUnit, Behat, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools (PHPStan, Psalm, or similar)

This is a remote position.

The Junior Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst Internship Program at EncryptEdge Labs is designed to provide aspiring SOC analysts with hands-on experience in monitoring and defending against cyber threats. Throughout the eight-week program, interns will engage in practical tasks that cover everything from threat landscape understanding, data collection and analysis, incident response, to vulnerability management and compliance.

Participants will gain exposure to SOC tools, log analysis using the ELK stack, security monitoring with Wazuh, and will develop skills in advanced incident handling and forensic analysis. The program culminates in a capstone project and final presentation that will demonstrate the intern's proficiency in SOC operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Learn and implement SOC techniques, including log management, security monitoring, and incident response.
  • Conduct in-depth data collection, traffic analysis, and log file analysis using tools like ELK and Wazuh.
  • Engage in threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and compliance reporting.
  • Participate in advanced incident handling, forensic analysis, and SOC efficiency improvement.
  • Complete a capstone project and present findings at the end of the internship.

Requirements

Core Attributes:
  • Passion for cybersecurity, with a focus on security operations and threat monitoring.
  • Consistency in meeting deadlines and completing tasks with attention to detail.
  • Strong documentation skills to present findings in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Effective communication skills for working collaboratively with mentors and peers.

Educational Background:
  • A degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

Foundational Knowledge:
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, firewall basics) and operating systems (Windows/Linux).
  • Familiarity with SOC workflows, log analysis, and key cybersecurity concepts is a plus.

Certifications (Preferred):
  • Splunk Fundamentals 1
  • TryHackMe SOC Level 1 Path
  • AlienVault OSSIM Training

Key Skillset:
  • Understanding of log analysis, including recognizing and interpreting security events.
  • Familiarity with alert triaging and prioritization in incident response.
  • Knowledge of common cyber threat vectors (e.g., phishing, malware, ransomware).

Tool Proficiency:
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as:
    • Splunk, Graylog, or QRadar.
  • Familiarity with endpoint monitoring tools like OSSEC and Wazuh.
  • Exposure to threat intelligence platforms (e.g., Recorded Future, AlienVault OTX).

Logistical Requirements:
  • Access to a computer and a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to set up and maintain a secure work environment (guidance will be provided).

Preferred Experience:
  • Completed courses or projects in SOC-related fields or security operations.
  • Participation in security challenges or labs focusing on threat detection and incident response.

Benefits

  • Hands-on Experience: Gain practical knowledge and skills in SOC operations, including threat monitoring, incident response, and log analysis using industry-standard tools.
  • Professional Development: Receive guidance on career development and opportunities to build a portfolio through real-world challenges and presentations.
  • Global Exposure: Participate in a global internship program, connecting with cybersecurity professionals from worldwide.
  • Certificate of Completion: Earn a certificate of completion at the end of the internship, demonstrating your proficiency in SOC analysis.
  • Letter of Experience: Interns who successfully complete the program will also receive a letter of experience, outlining the skills and competencies developed during the internship.
  • Letter of Recommendation: Outstanding interns will receive personalized letters of recommendation from EncryptEdge Labs.
  • Remote Learning: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote internship that allows you to work from anywhere.
  • Mentorship: Access support from experienced mentors and cybersecurity experts throughout the internship.
  • Job Opportunities: Top-performing interns may be recommended for job placements through our network of partners and clients, helping you advance your career in SOC analysis.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This is an 18-month contract position and works remotely in the Abbott Diabetes Care covering Western Ontario and Manitoba through Alberta. We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is the medical / scientific voice of expertise for Abbott Diabetes Care (ADC) products and therapeutic areas. This field-based role focuses on scientific engagement with ADC stakeholders. Provides scientific expert advice / guidance to key customers for ADC products & relevant therapeutic areas, including scientific exchange & professional development with key thought leaders / external experts and provides medical / scientific affairs support to the Canadian commercial team. The MSL serves to support the scientific credibility of ADC with established and emerging national & regional thoughts leaders, by supporting scientific dialogue and collaboration in areas of research, scientific publications, and scientific exchange, including unsolicited requests for medical information. They also interface regularly with appropriate Canadian commercial team members. They maintain a high level of knowledge to ensure credible dissemination of scientific information and dialogue with thoughts leaders, healthcare providers and healthcare organizations.

What You’ll Do

  • The Primary focus of the MSL will be to establish, foster and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders to build outstanding scientific data awareness and advocacy in the field.
  • Ensure a strong medical and scientific presence for ADC in key academic centers by facilitation of research initiatives.
  • Create and execute a short and long-term clinical, scientific support plan based on understanding unmet needs of the key opinion leaders and the competitive landscape.
  • Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members (Continuing Health Education, Market Access, Sales) while retaining functional independence.
  • The MSL will provide clinical protocol expertise to investigators for use in company sponsored and ensure that they are consistent with the company’s objectives, HC regulations, and necessary approvals.
  • Provide support to investigators about the process and areas of interest regarding the Investigator Initiated Study program

raw.description:
About BTA Design Services

Headquartered in Ottawa, BTA Design Services supports the electronic design community across Canada and internationally, specializing in ASIC and FPGA design, verification, and embedded software development. We strengthen our clients' engineering teams and accelerate the delivery of complete, production ready designs.

We are adaptable, efficient, and built around exceptional technical talent. Our continued growth reflects the trust our clients place in us, and we are currently searching globally for a Senior Physical Design Engineer with deep expertise in place and route.

About the Engagement

You will join BTA Design Services as an employee and work on behalf of one of our clients, an industry leader building advanced silicon platforms for next generation AI infrastructure. The work pairs leading edge CMOS design with the bandwidth and power demands of modern AI, and the client partners with the world's foremost foundries to bring frontier designs to production. Further details are shared with candidates under confidentiality during the interview process.

This engagement places you at the center of that work, delivering world-class ASICs on the most demanding technology nodes in the industry.

About the Position

As a Senior Physical Design Engineer, you will own backend implementation from netlist to GDSII on challenging blocks and sub-systems. You will apply advanced flows and techniques on single-digit FinFET technology nodes, working alongside a strong and experienced team to bring complex designs to closure. This is a senior, fully remote role, and you may be located anywhere.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run place and route implementation flows and analyze the results.
  • Create effective floorplans that support physically aware synthesis.
  • Drive designs to timing closure and run physical verification.
  • Debug issues spanning tools, timing constraints, DFT, and design.
  • Partner with the design team to improve RTL and make it implementation friendly.
  • Implement and apply timing ECOs.
  • Run PrimeTime and analyze timing reports.
  • Develop strategies to optimize power and area.
  • Run IR-drop analysis and identify optimal strategies to improve it.
  • Interface with analog and front-end teams to align on shared objectives.

Key Qualifications

  • 8 or more years of relevant experience in ASIC digital place and route.
  • Recent, hands-on experience with leading EDA tools and advanced flows (Synopsys and Cadence).
  • Strong understanding of advanced FinFET technology nodes, DRC rules, and node-specific P&R requirements.
  • Practical experience with floorplanning.
  • Solid grasp of CTS concepts and the ability to design clocks to meet timing requirements.
  • Working knowledge of IR-drop optimization strategies.
  • Experience with timing closure and ECO implementation (PT-ECO or Tweaker experience is an asset).
  • Strong scripting skills.
  • Exposure to several of the following: synthesis, StarRC, PT DMSA, RedHawk, Calibre, and formal verification (LEC or Formality).
  • A track record as a self-starter who also works well within a team.

Remote Work

This role is fully remote and open to candidates in any location. You will collaborate with distributed engineering teams across time zones, so strong written communication, self-direction, and the discipline to deliver independently are essential.

Why Work With Us

We offer challenging, stimulating technical work with companies that lead the world in technology and innovation. At BTA Design Services, we know our strength lies in the people who join us, so we foster an environment where everyone is trusted, valued, and engaged. We also believe work-life balance matters, and we give our engineers demanding, rewarding roles while leaving room for family, friends, and life beyond work.
This is a new position. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Disclaimer
BTA Design Services is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive, accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available on request at any stage of hiring.
This posting is for recruitment purposes only and does not constitute an offer of employment or a contract. Role scope, requirements, and compensation are subject to change. Client and product names are referenced for context and remain the property of their respective owners. All applications are handled in confidence.

Overview

The Sales Operations Manager manages the commercial execution, sales enablement, pricing governance, and operational support frameworks for assigned commercial sales teams. Reporting to Sales Leadership, this role oversees the lead-to-opportunity pipeline, commercial pricing compliance, commission administration, and sales analytics infrastructure. The position bridges commercial planning and field execution, ensuring sales teams operate with optimized sales processes, accurate pipeline tracking, disciplined pricing models, and clear performance reporting. Key stakeholders rely on this position to maintain CRM data integrity, administer monthly sales incentive plans, enforce pricing matrices, and present actionable performance analysis to commercial leaders.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Monitor and enforce selling price guidelines based on labor and material cost inputs, target gross margin thresholds, and competitive market dynamics.

  • Govern pricing authority matrices, exception workflows, and approval routing for non-standard quotes, custom project proposals, and special contract terms.

  • Conduct margin contribution, lifetime value, and discount analyses to track deal profitability across recurring and transactional service lines.

  • Manage CRM system adoption, user access, data integrity protocols, and regular data hygiene audits across account records and opportunity stages.

Experience

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

raw.description:
We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager. You understand the relationship between creative, data, audiences, and performance—and you know how to turn those insights into campaigns that drive sales.

The Role
As our Media Buyer & Creative Strategist, you'll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid advertising while also helping shape the creative direction behind our ads.
You'll analyze what's working, identify why it's working, develop new creative concepts to test, and work closely with our creative team, content creators, and other marketing partners to turn those ideas into high-performing ads.
We're looking for someone who is data-driven, creative, curious, and obsessed with finding what makes customers click—and buy.

What You'll Do
Media Buying & Campaign Management
  • Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
  • Own campaign setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, pacing, and optimization.
  • Monitor key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, and spend.
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns and quickly address underperforming campaigns.
  • Conduct audience, placement, offer, product, and campaign structure testing.
  • Manage daily and weekly budget pacing to ensure spend aligns with revenue and profitability goals.
  • Stay current on platform updates, advertising trends, and emerging paid media opportunities.
Creative Strategy
  • Develop the creative strategy behind paid advertising campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing hooks, messaging, product benefits, offers, formats, and angles.
  • Analyze winning and losing creatives to understand why they performed.
  • Turn performance data into clear, actionable creative briefs.
  • Partner with graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and UGC creators to develop new ad concepts.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and testing opportunities.
  • Help determine what types of content, messaging, and storytelling will resonate with different audiences.
  • Stay on top of trends in UGC, short-form video, social media, and performance creative.
Testing & Optimization
  • Develop and manage a structured creative testing strategy.
  • Test hooks, headlines, thumbnails, messaging, CTAs, offers, formats, products, and audiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and identify winning creative quickly.
  • Scale winning concepts across campaigns and platforms.
  • Continuously refresh creative to combat ad fatigue.
  • Use performance insights to influence future creative strategy.
Analytics & Reporting
  • Monitor campaign performance and identify trends, opportunities, and problems.
  • Analyze performance by campaign, audience, product, creative, and funnel stage.
  • Create regular performance reports and clearly communicate key takeaways.
  • Turn data into actionable recommendations—not just reports.
  • Work with the broader marketing team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from ad click through purchase.
  • Help develop a deeper understanding of what drives customer acquisition and conversion.
You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at an ad and ask "Did it work?"

You ask:
"Why did it work?"
"Who did it work for?"
"What should we test next?"
"How do we turn this into 10 more winning ads?"

You're equally comfortable looking at a spreadsheet of performance data and brainstorming a killer hook for a new TikTok ad.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to test. You're constantly looking for the next opportunity to improve performance.

raw.description:
SEI's Wealth business is seeking a results-oriented Practice Management Consultant to specialize in helping advisory firms gain and maintain scale—capacity, efficiency, and consistency—through their people and culture.

This people-centric leader will be responsible for helping to build and evolve SEI's Practice Management "scale" function in close partnership with SEI’s Technology and Operations Consultant and alongside the "growth" and "evolve" functions. An ideal candidate is willing and able to strategize, experiment, and execute solutions that deliver actionable and impactful advice and resources to SEI’s independent broker dealer and RIA clients. We're looking for an individual who is an expert in all things talent—hiring, onboarding, management, leadership, culture, talent development, and compensation planning—helping firms build and develop high-performing teams that drive sustainable growth, profitability, and enterprise value.

This role will also help advisory firms evolve their talent strategy to evolve in an everchanging, digital and AI-native world—reimagining roles, workflows, competencies, and career paths as AI and automation reshape how advisory work gets done. The consultant will guide firms in identifying which capabilities to build internally, which to augment with technology, and how to prepare their teams to thrive alongside AI-enabled tools and platforms.

Equally important, this consultant will help advisors think like business owners when it comes to their people—treating talent and productivity as strategic investments rather than operational expenses. They will coach firm leaders on measuring return on talent, aligning compensation and productivity, making disciplined hiring and workforce planning decisions, and building the systems, metrics, and management practices that turn a group of professionals into a scalable, high-performing enterprise.

This practice management role is tailored for individuals deeply enthusiastic about the independent advisor profession, committed to ongoing learning, and able to leverage their expertise in talent, people, and culture to drive meaningful outcomes within advisory practices. An ideal candidate possesses a background as a Chief People Officer, Head of Talent, HR leader, COO, business owner, coach, or consultant with substantial real-world experience helping service businesses build and scale high-performing teams, and is experienced and networked in the wealth management industry. They understand the unique talent challenges of independent advisory firms of all sizes—both small ($100M+) and large firms ($2B+ AUM)—and are excited to expand our practice management advice and resources to support scalable growth through people.

This role is a remote role. The role requires up to 20% travel.

What you will do:

  • Provide expert consultation, coaching, and education to independent advisory practices on talent-focused practice management topics, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, leadership development, organizational design, compensation planning, employee engagement, retention, and culture building.

  • Help advisory firms evolve their talent strategy for a digital and AI-native world—guiding them to redesign roles, workflows, competencies, and career paths so their teams can thrive alongside AI and automation.

  • Coach advisors to think like business owners when it comes to their people—treating talent and productivity as strategic investments, measuring return on talent, and applying disciplined workforce planning, capacity, and compensation decisions to drive profitability and enterprise value.

  • Be an integral, expert resource to help SEI attract and onboard mid-to-large and growing advisory firms ($500M+) by demonstrating how strong talent strategies drive business results.

  • Conduct thorough assessments of firms' talent, leadership, organizational, and cultural strengths, gaps, and readiness, and offer actionable and customized recommendations.

  • Develop and deliver engaging content including presentations, workshops, and training sessions to advisors and their teams on talent, people, culture, and related practice management topics.

  • Create scalable resources, tools, playbooks, frameworks, and educational content to help advisors plan for and execute team-building, leadership succession, and culture development as they grow organically and inorganically.

  • Build and deliver curriculum designed to develop the next generation of advisors, operations leads, and firm leaders—supporting career pathing, competency building, and long-term firm sustainability.

  • Lead and grow the SEI Next Gen Community, creating meaningful development experiences, peer networking opportunities, and ongoing educational programming for emerging advisor and operations talent.

  • Partner closely with SEI's People and Culture team to bring proven talent best practices to SEI's advisor clients, including StrengthsFinder, DISC, and other behavioral assessments, leadership development tools, and organizational effectiveness frameworks.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to advance how SEI connects talent with hiring advisory firms at scale.

  • Work in close partnership with fellow Practice Management Consultants across the growth, scale, and transition pillars to deliver holistic, integrated advice to advisors.

  • Build and manage strategic partnerships with external talent-focused experts, consultants, coaches, assessment providers, and service providers to deliver additional value to advisors.

  • Direct and manage special projects on the Advisor Services Team related to talent, workforce development, and culture-focused strategies.

  • Act as a thought leader by contributing articles, webinars, podcasts, and other educational content on talent, leadership, and culture within advisory firms.

What we need from you:

  • A minimum of 7 years of experience helping financial advisors and/or professional service firms grow, scale, and strengthen their businesses through roles in talent management, human resources, organizational development, coaching, consulting, practice management, or leadership within advisory firms.

  • Deep expertise across the full employee lifecycle, including workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, performance management, leadership development, compensation design, succession planning, engagement, and retention.

  • Working knowledge of how AI, automation, and digital tools are reshaping roles, workflows, and productivity within professional service and advisory firms—and how to translate that into practical talent strategy.

  • Business-owner mindset with the ability to help firm leaders view talent and productivity as strategic investments—measuring ROI, aligning compensation with outcomes, and connecting people decisions to enterprise value.

  • First-hand experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams—ideally within advisory firms or similar professional service businesses.

  • Deep understanding of the independent advisor and RIA landscape, including the unique talent, leadership, and culture challenges facing advisory firms today.

  • Experience designing and facilitating leadership development programs, team workshops, and educational experiences for professionals at all career stages.

  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with an ability to present complex topics in a clear, confident, and compelling way.

  • Experience in multi-channel communication mediums, including individual face-to-face interactions, in-person and virtual one-to-many presentations, live video, recorded video, phone and email.

  • Proven track record of driving successful team-building, leadership effectiveness, engagement, retention, and cultural outcomes for organizations and their staff.

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate high-level talent strategies into practical, actionable advice and plans.

  • Passion for developing others, particularly next-generation advisor and operations talent.

  • Highly collaborative, entrepreneurial, and growth minded.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time to support advisor events, presentations, community programming, and relationship management efforts.

What we would like from you:

  • Professional certifications such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, Gallup Certified Strengths Coach, DISC Certification, ICF Coaching credentials, CFP®, CIMA®, or CEPA® are advantageous but not mandatory.

  • Experience designing educational content, curriculum, playbooks, or decision frameworks to support advisor team-building and leadership development.

  • Experience helping firms adopt AI-enabled tools, redesign workflows, or build digital-first operating models.

  • Experience building and leading peer communities, mentorship programs, or leadership academies.

  • Familiarity with compensation benchmarking, career pathing frameworks, productivity metrics, and organizational design for advisory firms.

  • Proficiency in analyzing people metrics, productivity data, and organizational performance data to inform talent strategies and investment decisions.

  • Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun. Please see our website for more information.

SEI’s competitive advantage:

About the Role

Responsible for all aspects of strategizing and executing programmatic and awareness media campaigns across a variety of platforms and through direct media partnerships for clients. You are an expert when it comes to programmatic media and are proficient in at least one of the leading DSP platforms, including The Trade Desk, DV360, or Amazon DSP. You use your expertise to drive growth through initial planning, execution, monitoring, optimization, analysis, and reporting.

Beyond DSP activation, you understand how to execute high-impact campaigns across the broader awareness media landscape through direct partnerships, including endemic media, CTV, linear TV, Out of Home (OOH), and print.

This role will serve as the day-to-day subject matter expert (SME) for programmatic and awareness media for our clients, providing strategic recommendations, media planning, analysis, and reporting while responding to ad-hoc requests. You will be responsible for developing sophisticated media strategies, identifying the right channels and partners to reach target audiences, and delivering outstanding communication, service, and campaign performance for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the clients’ go-to expert in Programmatic and Awareness Media while overseeing the broader media strategy and performance of client campaigns
  • Own end-to-end campaign strategy and execution across programmatic platforms, with a strong emphasis on The Trade Desk, as well as direct media partnerships
  • Develop and execute integrated media strategies across programmatic, endemic, CTV, linear TV, OOH, print, and other awareness channels
  • Establish and manage direct publisher and media partnerships, including negotiations, media planning, activation, and reporting
  • Build and present multi-channel media plans with clear budget allocations, KPIs, pacing, and testing roadmaps
  • Drive continuous optimization using a deep understanding of real-time bidding, audience segmentation, platform algorithms, and broader media performance
  • Collaborate with creative and analytics teams to develop test-and-learn strategies that improve campaign effectiveness across channels
  • Provide high-touch communication with clients, including strategic recommendations, performance reporting, and actionable next steps
  • Stay ahead of trends across ad tech, emerging media opportunities, platform capabilities, and data privacy regulations to inform and future-proof campaign strategy
  • Analyze performance across channels, synthesize insights, and deliver executive-level reporting and recommendations
  • Develop strategic roadmaps and test plans that ladder up to client business goals with a strong focus on efficiency, scale, and brand impact
  • Train and mentor junior team members in programmatic and broader media planning and activation best practices

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media with deep, hands-on expertise in Programmatic advertising
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major DSP, including The Trade Desk, DV360, or Amazon DSP; experience with The Trade Desk is highly preferred
  • Experience establishing and managing direct media partnerships across endemic, CTV, linear TV, OOH, and/or print to support broader awareness media strategies
  • Demonstrated experience with publisher negotiations, media planning and strategy, campaign activation, and reporting
  • Experience developing sophisticated, multi-channel media strategies across both programmatic and direct media buys
  • Skilled in media analytics, forecasting, pacing, testing, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
  • Comfortable managing multi-million-dollar media budgets with accountability to campaign KPIs and broader business objectives
  • Excellent communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to simplify complex media strategies and drive alignment
  • Strong understanding of attribution, measurement, audience strategy, and incrementality testing
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and collaborative environment
