About Nucleus Global

Nucleus Global is a global leader in the medical communications space with locations across Europe, US, and APAC and a portfolio of 90-plus clients. It forms part of the Inizio Medical group, which includes Ashfield MedComms, ApotheCom, and MEDiSTRAVA. Its unique position as part of this international network, which includes three of the world’s top medical communications companies, gives it a key advantage over its commercial competitors in terms of the scale of its reach and depth of its expertise.

About the Role

As an Associate Client Services Director, you'll provide strategic leadership for a key Publications account. You'll serve as a trusted partner to senior client stakeholders, overseeing the successful delivery of integrated scientific communications programs while ensuring exceptional client service, operational excellence, and commercial performance.

Working closely with Scientific Services and cross-functional teams, you'll help shape account strategy, drive operational excellence, mentor and develop Client Services team members, and identify opportunities to strengthen and grow the client partnership.

Here's What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the day-to-day strategic management of a key client account delivering integrated Publications programs.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor and confidently navigating complex business conversations.
  • Partner with Scientific Services, Editorial, Digital, Creative, and Operations teams to deliver high-quality scientific communications that support client objectives.
  • Oversee account financial performance, including forecasting, budgeting, profitability, resource planning, and identifying opportunities for organic account growth.
  • Drive operational excellence by implementing best practices, improving delivery processes, and leading strategic initiatives that enhance account performance.
  • Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Client Services team members, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
  • Contribute to business development by leading proposals, RFPs/RFIs, pitches, and onboarding new business, while identifying opportunities to expand the existing client partnership.
  • Lead account strategy and planning, applying market insights and industry trends to develop innovative solutions that deliver long-term value.
  • Stay informed on developments across Medical Communications, scientific publications, AI, and omnichannel engagement, bringing forward new ideas and strategic thinking to clients and internal teams.

About You

  • Extensive Client Services experience within a medical communications agency, with significant experience supporting Publications accounts.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior pharmaceutical clients and successfully lead integrated scientific communications programs.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing budgets, forecasting, profitability, and driving organic account growth.
  • Experience leading and developing Client Services teams while collaborating effectively across Scientific Services, Editorial, Digital, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading business development activities, including proposals, pitches, and expanding existing client partnerships.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate client objectives and market insights into impactful Medical Affairs and Publications strategies.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative, solutions-focused approach and a passion for developing people and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Benefits:

  • Health coverage
  • 401(K) matching
  • PTO

In addition to a great benefits package, we are happy to talk flexible working. We are also known for our friendly and informal working environment with Friday socials across our offices, regular wellbeing weeks, and Town Hall events. We offer excellent opportunities for career and personal development, including opportunities to transfer your skills to our other offices around the world.

Our Pledge

At Nucleus Global, we are committed to encouraging a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging where everyone can bring each facet of themselves to work each day. We believe that strength in diversity and inclusivity is a driver of our success.

Nucleus Global is not accepting unsolicited résumés from search firms for this employment opportunity. Regardless of past practice, all résumés submitted by search firms to any employee of Nucleus Global and its affiliated companies by email, the Internet or in any form — without a current signed fee agreement for that position (as authorised by the Recruitment Manager) — will be deemed the sole property of Nucleus Global, and no fee will be paid in the event you are hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Nucleus Global is part of Inizio Medical. Inizio is a strategic partner for health and life sciences with a full suite of medical, marketing, advisory and engagement services.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

$130,000—$160,000 USD

QA & Verifications Specialist

Are you a skilled QA & Verification Specialist ready for a challenging and rewarding next step? Do you combine strong technical expertise with sharp analytical thinking and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality software? If so, Codekeeper invites you to join our team.

We're looking for a detail-oriented professional with a passion for problem-solving and a commitment to excellence. In this role, you'll help ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our systems while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Your work will directly contribute to maintaining the high standards our clients expect. If you thrive in a dynamic environment that values creativity, teamwork, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.

About the Role

The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity and reliability of our customers' software through verification processes. This role involves analyzing technical documentation, executing successful software builds in various programming languages, and validating software functionality against specified requirements. Additionally, you will be involved in conducting thorough testing of various scenarios, employing both manual and automated testing approaches. Your meticulous attention to detail will enable you to identify and report any bugs or glitches discovered during testing.

What You’ll Be Doing

Software Verification

  • Conduct verification of customer software using provided technical documentation

  • Achieve software builds across various programming languages

  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve build issues, ensuring software meets quality standards

Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Conduct end-to-end testing of application features across multiple scenarios

  • Use both manual and automated testing methods to validate functionality

  • Identify, document, and report bugs or inconsistencies to ensure a high-quality user experience

Technical Analysis and Problem Solving

  • Analyze software requirements and technical documentation to understand build processes and dependencies

Collaboration and Communication

  • Communicate effectively with team members and clients to understand requirements and provide updates

Continuous Learning and Improvement

  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and programming languages relevant to software verification

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of verification processes and practices

Why Codekeeper?

We were founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

🌐

What You Can Expect

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit .

Role Overview

The Enterprise Account Manager is an individual contributor responsible for driving revenue growth within a dedicated portfolio of high-potential enterprise accounts across the AEC sector. The role focuses on expanding Chaos’s footprint within existing accounts through strategic upsell, cross-sell, and solution adoption, while building deep, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders. Working as part of the global enterprise sales team and reporting to the Director, Enterprise Sales, this role contributes directly to ARR growth targets through disciplined pipeline management and the execution of complex, high-value expansion deals. This role requires a commercially sharp enterprise sales professional with a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Owns the end-to-end growth strategy for a select portfolio of high-potential AEC accounts (characterized by low current penetration relative to their potential spend).

  • Develop and execute plans to maximize ARR through strategic upsell, cross-sell, and solution adoption.

  • Cultivates and expands relationships with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers within assigned accounts globally, aligning Chaos solutions with their core business objectives and long-term strategic vision.

  • Creates and presents compelling ROI and business value analyses to justify significant new investments in the Chaos ecosystem, focusing on demonstrating measurable impact on the client's AEC workflows.

  • Leads the negotiation and closing of complex, multi-year expansion deals globally, navigating diverse procurement and legal processes unique to large AEC firms.

  • Identifies opportunities for workflow transformation within client organizations, positioning Chaos as integral to their design and visualization processes.

  • Develops and manages a robust, long-term sales pipeline for the assigned portfolio, providing accurate and reliable forecasting for expansion revenue.

  • Maintains expertise on global AEC industry trends, digital transformation initiatives, competitive landscapes, and client innovation priorities to proactively identify and seize growth opportunities.

Requirements

Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development within the AEC sector or an adjacent technology environment.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistently exceeding expansion and net-new revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environment: able to speak to the numbers, what was planned, and what was delivered.

  • Proven experience managing and growing a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, with clear ownership of upsell and cross-sell outcomes across long sales cycles.

  • Deep familiarity with AEC workflows, digital design and visualisation technologies, including BIM and real-time rendering, and SaaS licensing models.

  • Experience negotiating and closing complex, multi-year enterprise contracts, including development of executive-level business cases demonstrating TCO and ROI.

Required Skills

  • Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with commercial sharpness and discipline: manages long sales cycles without losing momentum, and closes with consistency.

  • Builds credible, trusted relationships with C-level and senior executive stakeholders, engaging at the level of business strategy rather than product features.

  • Develops rigorous account plans and pipeline strategies, using data and account intelligence to identify where to invest time and where to expand coverage.

  • Creates commercial momentum proactively, surfaces new expansion opportunities and builds pipeline rather than waiting for demand to appear.

  • Applies intellectual curiosity and second-order thinking to get beneath the surface of a client's needs, uncovering the true business pain points that shape a winning solution.

  • Translates complex technical capabilities into clear business value narratives that resonate with both technical users and executive decision-makers.

  • Operates with a high degree of autonomy and self-discipline: manages territory, pipeline, and stakeholder relationships without close oversight

  • Reads sales data, pipeline metrics, and market signals accurately, and uses that intelligence to prioritise effort and inform forecasting.

  • Fluency in English is required.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

We are looking for an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise-grade Power BI solutions. You will work closely with data, analytics, and business teams in a remote, EST-aligned environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and optimize Power BI semantic models (datasets), including data modeling, DAX measures, relationships, and performance tuning.

  • Connect to and transform data from multiple sources (SQL databases, cloud data warehouses, APIs, Excel, SharePoint, etc.) using Power Query (M language).

  • Document data models, measures, Python scripts, and report logic for maintainability and knowledge sharing.

  • Stay updated with Power BI and related Python capabilities and recommend improvements to existing solutions and development standards.

  • Participate in peer reviews and contribute to team coding/modeling standards.

  • Advanced proficiency in DAX (complex measures, time intelligence, filter context, variables, and optimization).

  • Strong skills in Power Query (M language) for data transformation and shaping.

  • Hands-on experience integrating Python with Power BI (Python scripts in Power Query, Python visuals, or external Python-based data processing pipelines).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (star/snowflake schema, relationships, cardinality, normalization vs. denormalization).

  • Experience with Power BI Service (workspaces, apps, gateways, scheduled refresh, deployment pipelines).

  • Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, Azure SQL, or similar) and writing efficient SQL.

  • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power BI Premium / Fabric capacity features (deployment pipelines, XMLA endpoints, large datasets, aggregation tables).

  • Familiarity with Azure Analysis Services, Analysis Services Tabular, or Microsoft Fabric.

  • Knowledge of data governance, sensitivity labels, and enterprise security practices in Power BI.

  • Experience using Python for advanced analytics, statistical modeling, or automation in conjunction with Power BI.

  • Exposure to version control (Git) and ALM practices for Power BI artifacts and related Python scripts.

  • Background in working with cross-functional teams in a remote or distributed setup.

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Finance Specialist for the Kentucky, Tennessee, and Virginia provides advanced financial management support across a shared services unit (pod), partnering with the Finance Manager, Finance Director, and business unit staff to deliver high-quality financial services. This role supports one or more states or organizational areas within the pod, providing shared finance expertise that flexes to meet business priorities and operational needs. The Finance Specialist serves as a trusted partner by delivering financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and other financial management activities while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and best practices.

We're Looking for You:

The Finance Specialist provides advanced financial support across assigned states, programs, or business units within a shared services pod. Working collaboratively with the Finance Manager and the Finance Director, the position supports budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, month- and year-end close activities, financial analysis, and ongoing financial management. The role develops a strong understanding of assigned business operations and provides timely financial guidance to support informed decision-making.

The Finance Specialist administers financial activities in accordance with TNC policies, procedures, and financial management best practices. The position prepares analyses, reconciliations, and reports; monitors financial performance; identifies trends, risks, and opportunities; and recommends process improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency, and stewardship of organizational resources. The role responds to moderately complex financial questions and serves as a resource to staff on finance processes, systems, and reporting.

Work Arrangement: This role is remote with preference to the Eastern or Central time zones.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Supports budgeting, forecasting, financial close, reporting, and other core financial management activities across assigned states or business units within the pod, and may assist in supporting other Southern Division business units or pods as the need arises.

  • Prepares and delivers financial reports, analyses, reconciliations, and other financial deliverables that support operational and strategic decision-making.

  • Monitors financial performance, identifies trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and communicates findings and recommendations to Finance Managers, Finance Directors, and business leaders.

  • Maintains the accuracy, integrity, and quality of financial data, reporting, systems, and business processes.

  • Supports compliance with organizational policies, internal controls, audit requirements, donor restrictions, and applicable regulatory requirements while identifying and escalating potential issues.

  • Provides guidance to staff on finance processes, systems, reporting tools, and standard operating procedures and may coordinate or deliver training as needed.

  • Partners with the Finance Manager, the Finance Director, Operations, Conservation, and Philanthropy staff to support financial planning, implementation of organizational priorities, and effective stewardship of resources.

  • Contributes to finance initiatives, process improvements, system implementations, and cross-functional projects that enhance consistency and effectiveness across the pod.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field and 3 years' related experience or equivalent combination.

  • Experience with accounting/financial issues and analysis.

  • Experience using accounting and financial reporting systems.

  • Technical experience with spreadsheet programs, general ledger reports and financial management tools.

  • Experience with GAAP, practices and regulations.

  • Experience, coursework or other training with U.S. Federal Uniform Guidance, state and local regulations, multilateral and international regulations, and standard contract clauses, as applicable.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Multi-lingual skills and/or multi-cultural experience appreciated.

  • Ability to manipulate, analyze and interpret data. Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel.

  • Strong organizational skills.

  • Accuracy, attention to detail and the ability to multi-task.

  • Non-profit accounting experience.

  • May require technical expertise on complex accounting/financial issues.

  • US government grants accounting experience.

This description is not designed to be a complete list of all duties and responsibilities required for this job.

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.

Salary Information:

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $68,000 - $85,000 annually. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

raw.description:
About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

About the role:

Salary range: $80k – $165k USD*

We are looking for smart engineers who love to code, seek challenging problems and appreciate recognition for excellent work. As part of the Core UX team, you will focus on refining existing product functionality to deliver an exceptional user experience. Your work will center on ensuring consistency across the product, maintaining a cohesive look and feel, and implementing performance improvements that directly impact end users. You’ll be paying close attention to the layout, interactions, responsiveness, and visual polish, that collectively give the product a premium, well-crafted feel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys iterative improvement, cares deeply about quality, and wants to shape the everyday experience of our users.

You'll collaborate with a global team of full-stack, data, ML, and DevOps engineers to build scalable backend solutions as we continue to grow. We're a small team where individual contributions have an outsized impact on both our technology and our business.

You'll be right at home if you:

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a track record of improving and polishing functionalities to bring premium user experience.
  • Embody hustle and grit, you're excellent at your craft and relentless in pursuing it.
  • Take full ownership of your work and drive projects to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Communicate proactively, surfacing blockers, asking the right questions, keeping stakeholders in the loop.
  • Thrive on experimentation: you're comfortable testing ideas, measuring results, and iterating quickly on problems no one has solved before.
  • Have strong fundamentals in system design, debugging, and problem-solving.
  • You have experience in a modern FE framework, preferably React.
  • Know Javascript, Typescript, or Python, though we're open to strong candidates from other OO backgrounds.
  • Have experience with serverless technologies (Lambda, EC2), asynchronous workflows, and cloud environments.
  • Are comfortable with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Bonus: experience with LLMs/generative AI, distributed systems.

What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary (based on experience level)*.
  • Significant equity options package.
  • Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $1T global industry.
  • 20 days of PTO a year.
  • Global team offsites.
  • Phone reimbursement. Gym reimbursment.
  • Student stipend.

*The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range.

Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

Senior Production Engineer

What is Cool About This Job

At WP Engine, we are on a mission to help our customers win online. Whether we're enabling an aspiring entrepreneur to turn a hobby into an online business or a multinational corporation to launch a new campaign in weeks instead of months, our platform elevates our customers toward success. By focusing on the customer experience, WP Engine has enjoyed spectacular growth, becoming the platform of choice for online agility.

As a Senior Production Engineer, you will lead a team of engineers utilizing an Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mentality to craft, build, and maintain complex systems at scale. You will be an essential part of taking our platform to the next level both in scale and functionality. Our production infrastructure is a hybrid environment utilizing virtual machines, containerization, and serverless technologies that hosts hundreds of thousands of customer websites, reaching a significant portion of the world's population. If you find solving complex problems irresistible, enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for delivering an elite customer experience, you may be the engineer we are looking for.

The Day to Day

  • Production Leadership: Curate an engineering culture that is biased toward shipping while maintaining very high standards of stability, performance, security, and scalability.

  • Infrastructure Management: Monitor, alert, investigate, and resolve production infrastructure challenges across public cloud environments (including GCP and AWS).

  • Automation & Optimization: Actively identify opportunities and implement automated, scalable solutions to optimize code and operational tasks, reducing toil across the platform.

  • Incident & Problem Management: Serve as a technical point of contact during critical issues, facilitate cross-functional communication, track alert trends, and perform root cause analysis (RCA) to drive structural improvements.

  • Change Execution: Execute production change and security requests, safely managing code deployments and patching pipelines.

  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering Management to align technical solutions and execution strategies with business goals and roadmap priorities.

  • Mentorship: Further an ecosystem of learning and professional development by coaching, mentoring, and leveling up exceptional engineers across the organization.

Your Expertise and Passion

  • Experience: 5+ years of software engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) experience building and running production-ready configurations at internet scale.

  • System Design: Strong history of system architecture, distributed microservices, and self-healing systems with efficient resource and network utilization.

  • Cloud & Containerization: Advanced expertise executing containerized workloads using Kubernetes orchestration and Docker across public cloud hosting providers.

  • Programming Languages: Proficient in structural and automated scripting using object-oriented languages, with strong experience in Python and Go preferred.

  • Web Serving Stack: In-depth understanding of the modern web serving stack and infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Linux, Nginx/Apache, MySQL, PHP, Ansible, Terraform).

  • Observability: Hands-on familiarity implementing metrics, monitoring, and alerting systems (such as Prometheus or EFK stacks) to maximize infrastructure visibility.

  • Mindset: A forward-thinking learner with superb analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis capabilities who loves a team-first environment.

Perks and Benefits

  • Company Stock Options (Every employee is an owner in the company)

  • Superannuation Program

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Supplemental Maternity & Paternity Pay

  • Generous Vacation Time (Who doesn't like time off)

  • One-time $745 AUS Home Office Stipend

  • Company Wellness Days

Equal Opportunity Statement

WP Engine is an equal opportunities employer. We're a diverse and inclusive set of people brought together by our shared purpose and values. We see our culture as an advantage and believe in hiring the best and providing an environment where the best get better. Bring your full self to WP Engine!

At WP Engine, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. WP Engine is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law. ​

Position Title:

Development Director, Southeast Region, Georgia Market

Supervisor/Manager:

Southeast Division Vice President

Employment Classification:Full-time, Exempt

Date:February 2026

Location: Remote in metro Atlanta

Salary: $100,000

The Lupus Foundation of America (LFA)is dedicated to improving the quality of life for all people affected by lupus through programs of research, education, and advocacy. The Development Directorplays a key role in successful achievement of all aspects of the Georgia market operations, including revenue generation, leadership development, corporate engagement, constituent support and education, strategic planning and capacity building. The position reports to the Southeast Division Vice President.

The Development Director is responsible for the successful achievement of all fundraising activities within the Georgia market, including the Walk to End Lupus Now events through, high-impact peer to peer fundraising, corporate sponsorship, team recruitment, and committee and volunteer leadership development and cultivation. The Development Director is also responsible for regional constituent support and engagement, including planning and execution of the Region’s Lupus & You Empowerment Conference education events.

This is a highly collaborative position working with every department in the organization, including Care Support & Services, Research, Marketing & Communications, Advocacy & Government Relations, and Development & Fundraising.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Formulate, implement, and lead strategies and tactics for fundraising and development activities to ensure consistent growth and successful achievement of region success metrics.
  • Lead the planning and execution of special events, primarily the Walk to End Lupus Now Events through recruitment, corporate sponsorship, fundraising and committee and volunteer leadership development and cultivation within assigned geographic territory.
  • Lead the planning and execution of Region’s Lupus & You Empowerment Conferences, including securing sponsorships, venues, speakers and physician partnerships and all communication and recruitment.
  • Building relationships with key volunteers, participants, corporate partners, sponsors and community leaders
  • Achieve assigned revenue goals by developing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, constituents, sponsors, donors, committees, corporate and community partners.
  • Serve as the lead Development staff to drive revenue generation and growth opportunities for all fundraising and education events in the market.
  • Establish LFA presence within assigned geographic territory and develop relationships which will lead to future support, engagement and development opportunities.
  • Maintain detailed, timely and accurate database of relevant engagement information and acknowledgement of sponsorships, grants and gifts.
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in order to ensure the attainment of market financial goals.

Qualifications:

  • 7-10 years of experience in special event fundraising and relationship development.
  • Strong volunteer recruitment and management experience.
  • Broad based fundraising knowledge, experience and skill in nonprofit management with emphasis on strategic planning, financial management, and market development.
  • Superior relationship development skills.
  • Effectively multi-task, establish priorities, and work in a fast-paced environment. Efficient in time management and can meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Detail-oriented and strong organizational skills. Demonstrate competency when handling diversified assignments.
  • Team player who can interface with all levels of staff and volunteers. Strong capability to leverage relationships and negotiate agreements.
  • Excellent written, oral, and communication skills.
  • Superior active listening, observation, analytical, and problem recognition and solving skills.
  • Ability to work and make judgments independently and take initiative.
  • Well-disciplined and a self-starter.
  • Volunteer Health Agency background desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Remote position based in Georgia.

Working at Lupus

The Lupus Foundation of America prioritizes the health and well-being of its employees. The Foundation offers a highly competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision and life insurance covered at 100% for the employee. We provide sick, vacation, and personal leave, and we follow the federal government for holiday closures. Other benefits include Health Reimbursement Arrangement, Flexible Spending Accounts and an Employee Assistance Program.

Other Details

  • Must have a dedicated home office or workspace with reliable internet connectivity, ensuring the ability to perform job duties effectively and participate in virtual meetings without disruptions.
  • Ability to interact with people of all ages and cultural backgrounds.
  • LFA participates in E-Verify.
  • Background checks are required.

JOIN US
If you’re a dynamic, mission-driven individual passionate about driving positive change and improving lives, we encourage you to apply! At LFA, your contributions will help solve themystery of lupus and create a world where people with lupus can live healthier, fuller lives while making a lasting difference.

Zur Unterstützung bei Auftragsspitzen sowie zur langfristigen Betreuung fester Mandantenstämme suchen wir kompetente und selbstständig agierende Abrechnungsexperten auf Honorarbasis.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben als Freelancer/Minijobber

Eigenverantwortliche Abrechnung ambulanter ärztlicher Leistungen sowie systematische Überprüfung medizinischer Behandlungsdokumentationen auf Vollständigkeit und Konformität mit den aktuellen Abrechnungsrichtlinien.

Sie verfügen über fundierte, langjährige Expertise in mindestens einer der folgenden Abrechnungsarten?

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit

Kenntnisse in mehreren Bereichen sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrung in mehreren medizinischen Fachbereichen, z. B. Orthopädie/Unfallchirurgie, Kardiologie, Innere Medizin etc.

Benefits

  • Planbarkeit: Eine langfristig angelegte Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßiger und planbarer Projektauslastung, abgestimmt auf Ihre individuellen Kapazitäten.

raw.excerpt: Our merchants are the heart and soul of our business, and the Merchant Success Team at Loop exists to optimize the value of the Loop partnership to their business.
raw.description:
Our merchants are the heart and soul of our business, and the Merchant Success Team at Loop exists to optimize the value of the Loop partnership to their business. This begins with the merchant onboarding experience and continues through ongoing support and strategic account management.

As a Mid-Market Merchant Success Manager at Loop, you will own a portfolio of growing merchants and help them realize measurable value from their partnership with Loop. Through consultative relationships, strong prioritization, repeatable playbooks, and scalable engagement, you will drive retention, product adoption, and expansion across your book of business.

This role requires the ability to balance proactive strategy with portfolio efficiency, use data and health signals to focus time where it will have the greatest impact, and deliver a consistently strong merchant experience at scale.

Right away, we’ve listed what we think you’ll be spending your time on. We’re growing fast, and growth means the challenges we’ll work on together will change as we lead Loop through new and different phases.

This is an indispensable role with us, so we’ll be looking for you to have examples of when you’ve tackled these challenges throughout your career. We’ve laid out the experience we think is important to set you up for success in this role. But, we appreciate that different humans will solve problems in different ways, so we don’t expect you to fit exactly in a box of requirements.

At Loop, we're intentional about how we work so everyone can do their best work. We call this our Blended Working Environment. Our team is based across our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, as well as Hub and Secluded locations through the United States, select Canadian provinces, the United Kingdom, and select Australian states.

For this position, we are looking for a teammate located in the United States.

Challenge: Be accountable for revenue retention and expansion goals for Loop’s mid-market merchants.

  • Your main priority is to make our merchants successful, and you’ll use any and all of your resources to make it happen.

  • Be accountable for revenue retention, renewals, expansion, and retraction mitigation across your assigned portfolio.

  • Use merchant goals, health signals, engagement, product usage, and renewal timing to prioritize your book of business and determine where proactive intervention will have the greatest impact.

  • Lead complex renewal and commercial conversations, clearly articulating Loop's value and competitive differentiation to stakeholders across the merchant's organization.

  • You’ll partner cross-functionally with Account Executives to cross-sell our products to your existing merchant base.

Your Experience:

  • 3+ years of customer success or account management experience with mid-market or enterprise businesses for B2B SaaS products. If you have experience working with the ecommerce industry, that is a huge differentiator for us!

  • You’ve managed accounts for a long enough period of time that you oversaw the renewal process with them, and have successfully renewed many accounts.

  • You know what it’s like to be accountable for revenue goals, and you’ve accomplished (or exceeded!) them in the past.

  • You have tried to find true ways to uncover and close new opportunities with accounts, and are willing to share a few examples with us.

Challenge: Build impactful consultative relationships with your merchants to drive additional value through Loop.

  • Host quarterly business reviews with your key accounts, showing up with content that aligns merchants priorities to Loop's capabilities and the outcomes that matter most to their business.

  • Engage in regular, creative touchpoints with your accounts to get in front of any issues prior to renewal and avoid merchant churn.

  • Increase the usage and adoption of all Loop’s features by communicating new feature updates to your accounts, focusing on the value they’ll provide to that specific merchant.

  • Make Loop better by talking to merchants constantly and reporting product enhancement themes and feedback to the rest of the Merchant Success team.

Your Experience:

  • You’ve been involved in merchant communications in prior roles, either owning 100% of your communications or partnering with marketing teams to strategically generate messaging.

  • You love data, and you’ve established processes for yourself to extract data, analyze it and use it to create compelling value stories for your customers.

  • You have examples of how your proactive interactions and strong relationships with customers have directly contributed to mitigating churn, and have increased usage of product features.

  • Creating exceptional partnerships with your merchants and becoming one of their favorite people to work with are always top priorities for you.

  • You can share a couple examples of how you’ve thoughtfully shared customer feedback that led to updates to your product.

  • You understand the different stages of the customer journey, and that there’s a difference in how they should be communicated with.

Challenge: Operate efficiently and partner cross functionally.

  • Use AI, automation, templates, and operating rhythms to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and create more time for high-impact merchant engagement.

  • Partner effectively with Sales, Onboarding, Support, Product, Solutions, and other teams to move merchant needs forward with clear context and ownership.

  • Navigate merchant issues through the appropriate channels, maintain clear communication, and stay accountable for the overall merchant experience even when another team owns the resolution.

  • Surface recurring merchant feedback and product themes with clear examples, business impact, and appropriate expectations about potential action.

Your Experience:

  • You have managed a sizable portfolio while maintaining strong organization, responsiveness, and proactive engagement.

  • You can explain how you use AI or automation to work more efficiently and improve the quality or consistency of customer support.

  • You collaborate well across teams and can create momentum without relying on direct authority.

  • You can share examples of customer feedback that contributed to product, process, or service improvements.

Loop Story
Commerce should feel effortless. Every product adored, every order perfect, every customer loyal for life. But reality is messier: operations get tangled, margins grow thin, and trust is fragile. That’s where Loop steps in. We create confidence where commerce fails.
We started by fixing returns and exchanges. Today, we’re building a connected commerce operations suite — powering everything from order tracking to fraud prevention, with hundreds of innovations in between. Grounded in data and insight, our platform helps merchants make smarter decisions with every transaction. Over 5,000 of the world’s most loved brands trust Loop to turn cost centers into growth engines. Our mission is simple: protect margins, delight customers, and help merchants build businesses that last.
Life at Loop is rooted in our core values. We balance high empathy with high standards, knowing that work is better when we can show up authentically and resilience is built by facing challenges head-on. We expect you’ll grow quickly, learning skills that last far beyond your time here. Loop is a formative chapter in your career — a chance to shape the future of commerce and to leave better than when you arrived.
Learn more about us here: .
You can review our privacy notice here.

🧩 Role Overview

About the Client:

Our client is an established, family-owned logistics service provider and freight brokerage dedicated to empowering commerce through efficient and innovative supply chain solutions. Built on a foundation of integrity, sustainability, and long-term relationships, they operate as a deeply trusted partner for businesses across multiple sectors.
They pride themselves on a culture of constant communication and total transparency, providing 24/7 round-the-clock service to ensure time-sensitive freight is delivered seamlessly. By blending industry experience with personalized care, they provide an agile, fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to grow and directly contribute to the success of global trade.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will start with a strong focus on tracking, tracing, and operational execution, with a clear trajectory to advance into a commission-earning Account Manager role.

The ideal candidate possesses exceptional customer service, problem-solving abilities, and a basic foundation in logistics operations. Rather than general freight, this role prioritizes experience in specialized freight sectors, specifically Produce and Open Deck (Oversize, Overweight, and Overwidth) cargo.


🔑 Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide high-level track and trace coverage, ensuring real-time shipment visibility and accurate system updates.
  • Proactively problem-solve operational hurdles during weekend and peak-season shifts to prevent delivery delays.
  • Maintain accurate communication with carriers regarding load specifics, pickup/delivery addresses, and schedule adherence.
  • Learn and adapt to market pricing platforms to effectively quote and negotiate competitive rates with open-deck and produce carriers.
  • Smoothly transition from an internal operations support position to a client-facing account management role based on performance.

🎯 Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both Spanish and English (Required).
  • Core Experience: 1–2 years of experience in track and trace, logistics coordination, or a freight brokerage setting.
  • Niche Expertise: Proven experience or strong familiarity handling Produce and/or Open Deck (Oversize / Overweight / Overwidth) freight is highly preferred.
  • Competencies: Strong negotiation skills, confident telephone demeanor, and excellent multi-tasking capabilities.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong customer service mentality with the capacity to stay calm and resourceful under high-pressure, peak-season conditions.
  • Systems & Software:
    • Experience with Load Boards (DAT, Truckstop) is strongly preferred.
    • Experience with Transportation Management Systems (specifically Tai Software) is strongly preferred.
    • Experience with 3CX dialer systems is a plus.

Tiered Career Path:

  • Tier C (Entry / Track & Trace): Focuses heavily on track and trace, answering driver calls, verifying pickup details, and providing proactive client updates.
  • Tier B (Operations Specialist): Introduces market-rate quoting, carrier sourcing, and carrier rate negotiations.
  • Tier A / S (Account Manager): Full management of key clients, independent quoting, and carrier book management. At this stage, the role transitions to a Monday–Friday schedule.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

This position is open only to candidates currently based in and legally authorized to work in one of the following EMEA locations: South Africa, Serbia or Romania. Fully home-based working is available in all three locations.

Picture Yourself At Parexel:

The Data Surveillance Analyst (DSA) is responsible for analyzing scientific and operational data to support the Data Surveillance process and reviewing project-specific Quality Tolerance Limits. They assist in developing Data Surveillance Plans (DSPs) and conduct defined project reviews. The DSA also attends internal and external Data Surveillance meetings, where they present relevant findings to the project team.

What You'll Do At Parexel:

Data Surveillance Plan Development and Technology Configuration:

  • Support the development of a robust Data Surveillance Plan, including Key Risk Indicators, Quality Tolerance Limits, and central statistical analysis.

  • Configure and Maintain Data Surveillance technologies (e.g., CluePoints Central Monitoring Platform):

- Create data import mapping for all data sources

- Create and set-up standard and bespoke KRIs.

- Create and set-up statistical analysis parameters.

Data Surveillance Review:

  • Review relevant data via the scoped technologies and additional sources as required to support reviews designated for the DS Analyst per the project specific Data Surveillance Plan, including project specific Quality Tolerance Limits.

  • Document findings from Data Surveillance activities in the DS Findings Form, Issue Tracking system(s) and other as appropriate.

  • Provide feedback and work with Technology teams to identify potential solutions that match the business and technology strategy.

  • Apply working knowledge and judgment to identify and evaluate potential data quality trend, outliers and emergent issues. Determine and implement appropriate follow-up action with the input of other / relevant parties and / or guidance provided, if applicable.

  • Actively participate in Investigator and other external or internal meetings and audits & regulatory inspections as required.

  • Recognize impact of study non-compliance/issues/delays/data quality signals and communicate/ promptly escalate to FL any site and/or study issues that require immediate action.

  • Perform core reviews per DS Plan.

  • Document instances of atypical data per DS Plan.

  • Collaborate with DS Team Members to correlate findings from various sources.

  • Support Project Leads with DS Review meeting, driving reviews and decisions as needed and agreeing on actions.

  • Engage DS Team to compile signals/actions into client ready list.

  • Support documentation of actions in CluePoints Issue Management system (links to IH for any on-site interventions required).

  • Complete, share, and file Central Monitoring Report.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role:

  • University degree (medical, biological science, pharmacy, and/or data analytics).

  • Fluent English.

  • Basic SAS or R programing experience required.

  • Experience with Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) processes and data surveillance methods.

  • Familiarity with centralized monitoring and Data Driven Monitoring practices.

  • Proficient in data analysis, trend identification, and issue triage.

  • Proficient in relevant software: CTMS, EDMS, MS Office.

  • Basic understanding of SDTM domains and data operations concepts.

  • Experience with CluePoints would be a strong asset.

  • Client-focused with strong quality orientation.

  • Effective in matrix and global virtual team environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including presentation abilities.

  • Strong time management and multitasking capabilities.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Why join us:

Be part of groundbreaking projects that are pushing the boundaries of the industry. Experience a collaborative and inclusive work environment that highly appreciates your expertise. Unlock your full potential with professional growth and development opportunities. Enjoy work life balance and flexible working hours.

If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but you know of someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

raw.description:
Experience: 3+ years

Role & Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data models in Snowflake using dimensional modeling techniques such as star and snowflake schemas to support reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Build, test, and document dbt models across staging, intermediate, and mart layers while following established development standards and best practices.
  • Support Snowflake performance and cost optimization activities, including query tuning, warehouse monitoring, and efficient data storage practices.
  • Design and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines to ingest and transform data from multiple sources such as ERP systems, APIs, flat files, and cloud platforms into Snowflake.
  • Develop automation scripts and data processing workflows using Python and cloud-native services.
  • Implement data quality validations, perform data reconciliation, and assist in maintaining data lineage and documentation.
  • Work closely with business analysts, reporting teams, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment activities, and continuous improvement of data engineering processes.

Experience

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related role, with hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience in a production environment.
  • Good understanding of Snowflake data warehousing concepts, including data modeling, SQL development, performance tuning, and data loading processes.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt for model development, testing, documentation, and deployment.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and data transformation techniques.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and API integration.
  • Experience building and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related data services.
  • Understanding of Git version control and CI/CD concepts.

Must have skills: Data Modeling (Strong), Snowflake

Good to have skills: ETL Concepts (Capable), Power BI (Capable), Python (Capable)

raw.description:
über uns – talentspring academy group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.
Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen.

Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Unsere Programme qualifizieren für zukunftsrelevante Berufsfelder in Bereichen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Online Marketing und Digital Sales – flexibel gestaltet, arbeitsmarktnah und mit echten Karriereperspektiven.

Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld.

Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?

über die rolle

Als Dozent:in für die Umschulung "Kaufmann/-frau für Büromanagement" übernimmst du die fachliche und didaktische Verantwortung für die Vermittlung aller relevanten Kompetenzen entlang des Ausbildungs-Rahmenlehrplans. Du gestaltest motivierenden, praxisnahen Unterricht und begleitest unsere Teilnehmer:innen auf ihrem Weg zur IHK-Prüfung.

Dabei bringst du deine kaufmännische und organisatorische Expertise in digitale Unterrichtsformate ein, entwickelst modernes Lehrmaterial, förderst aktiv die Lernmotivation und hilfst Menschen beim beruflichen Neustart.

deine aufgaben

1. Fachlicher Unterricht & Curriculum-Umsetzung

  • Planung und Durchführung des Unterrichts nach dem Ausbildungs-Rahmenlehrplan
  • Vermittlung von Themen wie: Büro- und Geschäftsprozesse, Auftragsbearbeitung, kaufmännische Steuerung und Buchführung, Personalwirtschaft, Sekretariat/Assistenz sowie Kommunikation und Kooperation
  • Vermittlung der gängigen Wahlqualifikationen (z. B. Assistenz und Sekretariat, Kaufmännische Steuerung und Kontrolle)
  • Kombination aus Theorie, Praxisbeispielen und interaktiven Methoden (z. B. Fallstudien, Gruppenarbeiten)
2. Prüfungsvorbereitung & Lernbegleitung
  • Zielgerichtete Vorbereitung der Teilnehmenden auf schriftliche und praktische IHK-Prüfungen (inkl. report-basiertem Fachgespräch)
  • Regelmäßige Lernstandskontrollen, Feedback und individuelle Lernbegleitung
3. Materialerstellung & Qualitätssicherung
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Unterrichtsmaterialien und digitalen Inhalten (z. B. Moodle)
  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung des Curriculums anhand von Trends und Feedback
4. Organisation & Kommunikation
  • Dokumentation von Lernfortschritt und Anwesenheit
  • Enge Abstimmung mit dem Lehrenden-Team, Fachbereichsleitung und Verwaltung

das bringst du mit

Fachlich:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Kauffrau/-mann für Büromanagement, Betriebswirt:in oder kaufmännisches Studium (BWL, Verwaltung, o. ä.)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Büroorganisation, Office Management, Verwaltung oder Assistenz
  • Kenntnisse in Themen wie MS Office, ERP-/Buchhaltungssystemen sowie kaufmännischen Prozessen
  • AEVO-Nachweis (AdA-Schein) oder Bereitschaft, diesen bis Dezember 2026 zu erwerben
Pädagogisch & organisatorisch:
  • Erfahrung in der Ausbildung von Azubis oder Erwachsenenbildung
  • Sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools und Lernplattformen
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Wissensvermittlung
Formales:
  • Wohnsitz in Berlin oder NRW
  • Keine Ausschlussgründe gem. BBiG § 30
  • Nachweise über Ausbildung, AEVO, Berufspraxis und ggf. IHK-Ausbilderstatus erforderlich

was wir dir bieten

  • 100 % Remote, 100 % digitalfähig: Du arbeitest vollständig ortsunabhängig – mit Tools und Strukturen, die funktionieren.
  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Du begleitest Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem anerkannten beruflichen Kompetenznachweis und verbesserst damit unmittelbar ihre Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Du wirst Teil unseres festen Teams und übernimmst eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle innerhalb unserer wachsenden Academy-Struktur.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Du bringst Deine fachliche und didaktische Erfahrung aktiv in Unterricht, Prüfungsvorbereitung und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Lernformate ein.
  • Professionelles Team: Dich erwartet ein engagiertes, kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und enger Zusammenarbeit.

unser bekenntnis zur chancengleichheit

Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen.

raw.description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

ASRC Federal Advanced Research (AFAR), a subsidiary of ASRC Federal Holding Company, is currently recruiting for a remote Junior Budget Execution Analyst to support a federal government client located in Silver Spring, MD. Work hours for this position are aligned to the Eastern Time Zone.

Key Role:

The successful candidate will provide budget planning and budget execution support for the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)/National Weather Service (NWS) client. The candidate will assist in creating and maintaining the spreadsheets, tools, forms, templates, and instructions to support various monthly and quarterly reports and meetings. They will work with various branches to ensure that the new and existing financial processes are understood and implemented correctly. Integral to the role is the ability to analyze data to understand trends, forecast potential budget issues, and to plan and take corrective actions. The candidate will track NWS grants and contracts as they move through planning, funding, and execution. Finally, they will provide analyses, assessments, and recommendations relating to financial management activities, among other duties as assigned.

This is a remote position. The duties for this role include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide budget execution support to a NWS Financial Management Center (FMC) or Headquarters.
  • Become adept at pulling reports from the NOAA financial systems, including the Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), and the Financial Management Data System (FMDS)
  • Summarize quantitative data for monthly commitment, obligation, and contract status reports as well as a variety of complex payment reports
  • Assist with creating and monitoring monthly and annual obligation plans.
  • Track funds transferred in from other NOAA or NWS Financial Management Centers
  • Understand the various types of accounting codes (i.e., program, project, and tasks codes) being used and the business rules that govern them.
  • Process documentation for financial corrections.
  • Conduct variance analysis by comparing planned obligations to actual obligations; justify the reason behind variances to FMC leadership and NOAA headquarters.
  • Create and utilize tracking tools to monitor NWS contracts and grants as they move through planning, clearance, funding, and execution.
  • Transform accounting system data into Excel spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Produce, maintain, and update templates, forms, process documents, and slides for NWS reviews.
  • Respond to data calls from other FMCs, NWS Headquarters, NOAA Headquarters, the Department of Commerce, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and/or Congress.
  • Enter data, as requested, into the Financial Management Data System.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus 2 years of experience in federal budgeting or related industries (e.g., finance, budgeting, accounting or other highly quantitative field). 4 years of relevant experience may be used as a substitute for a bachelor's degree. A master’s degree may be used as a substitute for 2 years of experience. A PhD may be used as a substitute for 4 years of experience.
  • Ability to transform data and findings into concise, user-friendly spreadsheets and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Excellent oral presentation skills with the ability to brief findings and materials to management.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in groups of senior leaders, knowing when to speak up versus deferring to management.
  • Work proactively to anticipate management’s questions and meet their needs before being asked
  • Sift through large amounts of data and reports to find answers to management’s questions in a timely manner
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including customer service skills, to properly manage customer expectations and respond to customer requests
  • Knowing when to ask for help to be able to meet assigned deadlines

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with the NOAA accounting system is a plus.
  • Experience with government financial systems and terminology is preferred.
  • Passion for the NOAA mission is a plus.

We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); education assistance; paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. The salary offered will depend on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal equity, business needs, and other factors permitted by law. Posted pay ranges are a general guideline only and are not a guarantee of compensation or salary.

As Head of Amazon, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of the company's brand growth on Amazon. You will be responsible for monitoring and enhancing SKU-Level Performance across the company's diverse portfolio and expanding its presence through successful new product launches.

If you are a strategic thinker who can collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and has a proven track record in managing products on Amazon's platform - we would love to hear from you!

It is a fast-growing small company that manages Amazon accounts and runs its own brand, offering eco-friendly products. The team works fully remotely, allowing for flexibility and efficiency while maintaining strong collaboration.

The company operates in an international and rapidly evolving market, providing a dynamic work environment. It encourages creativity and initiative, giving team members the opportunity to bring new ideas to life and make a real impact.
