raw.description:
Operations & Administrative Coordinator

Location: Remote
Team: Total Commerce
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Total Commerce

Total Commerce is an ecommerce agency focused on helping brands grow through Shopify, ecommerce strategy, development, retention, optimization, and operational support. We work with a wide range of growing and established brands and operate as a small, collaborative team where organization, follow-through, and visibility into the business are critical.

We are looking for an Operations & Administrative Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of the agency, with a particular focus on internal reporting, sales and marketing coordination, and administrative organization.

This is not a traditional executive assistant role. We are looking for someone who enjoys creating structure, working with data, keeping initiatives moving, and making sure important tasks do not fall through the cracks.

Role Overview

The Operations & Administrative Coordinator will help ensure leadership has clear visibility into how the business is performing and that key sales, marketing, and operational initiatives stay on track.

The role will own recurring internal reporting, support business development and marketing execution, maintain organizational systems, and help leadership follow through on priorities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets, confident using AI and technology, and willing to proactively follow up with team members and leadership when something needs attention.

Key Responsibilities

Agency Reporting & Operations

  • Prepare and maintain weekly employee utilization reporting, including:
    • Total hours worked
    • Billable vs. non-billable hours
    • Utilization by employee
  • Prepare weekly project reporting, including:
    • New projects
    • Active projects
    • Projects nearing completion or sunsetting
    • Project budgets and hours used
    • Remaining work or revenue to be billed
    • Projects requiring leadership attention
  • Maintain project-level profitability and P&L reporting.
  • Prepare quarterly profitability reporting for retainer clients.
  • Support preparation and organization of the agency's monthly P&L.
  • Ensure internal reporting is accurate, consistent, and delivered on schedule.
  • Flag missing information, unusual trends, budget concerns, or other issues for leadership review.
  • Maintain recurring operational reporting calendars and processes.

Sales & Business Development Support

  • Maintain and organize prospect and lead lists.
  • Track outreach, responses, next steps, and follow-up dates.
  • Help prepare outbound sales emails using AI, existing templates, leadership drafts, and prospect research.
  • Create or organize email drafts in Front for leadership review and sending.
  • Proactively remind leadership when follow-ups or outreach are due.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene and ensure opportunities have accurate stages, notes, and next steps.
  • Assist with prospect research and account-based marketing initiatives.
  • Support proposal and sales-process administration as needed.

Marketing & Initiative Coordination

  • Help coordinate agency marketing initiatives and campaigns.
  • Build timelines and task plans around marketing programs, events, partnerships, and campaigns.
  • Coordinate logistics for events, dinners, and other business development initiatives.
  • Help manage guest lists, vendors, budgets, assets, deadlines, and follow-up activities.
  • Work with leadership and internal team members to keep newsletters, case studies, campaigns, and other marketing initiatives progressing.
  • Ensure deadlines and commitments are documented and followed through.

Administrative & Organizational Support

  • Provide light inbox and administrative support when needed.
  • Help organize shared documents and ensure files are stored in the appropriate client or internal folders.
  • Maintain clean and organized internal systems across tools such as Google Drive, Asana, Front, Harvest, and CRM platforms.
  • Assist with research, documentation, and miscellaneous operational projects.
  • Identify recurring administrative tasks that could be simplified, standardized, or automated.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience in operations, agency coordination, business operations, project coordination, executive support, or a similar role.
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort working with operational and financial data.
  • Basic understanding of concepts such as revenue, budgets, margins, utilization, and P&L reporting.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (international school background strongly preferred).
  • Comfortable using AI tools to research, organize information, and develop first drafts.
  • Comfortable learning and working across multiple software platforms.
  • Ability to take loosely defined tasks and turn them into an organized plan.
  • Strong follow-through and a willingness to proactively chase missing information or overdue actions.
  • Confidence communicating with senior team members and reminding leadership about deadlines and commitments.
  • Ability to manage recurring responsibilities while also supporting one-off projects and initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within an agency, ecommerce business, consulting company, or other professional services environment.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or ecommerce.
  • Experience with tools such as Asana, Harvest, Front, Attio or another CRM, Google Workspace, and AI tools.
  • Previous experience producing utilization, profitability, project-budget, or other internal business reporting.

What Success Looks Like

Within this role, success means:

  • Leadership can quickly understand how the agency is performing without having to manually gather information.
  • Weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting is delivered accurately and consistently.
  • Project budget and profitability concerns are surfaced early rather than after the fact.
  • Sales opportunities and follow-ups do not disappear because someone forgot to revisit them.
  • Marketing initiatives have clear timelines and continue moving forward.
  • Internal documents, systems, and processes remain organized.
  • Leadership spends less time managing administrative details and more time focused on strategy, clients, and growth.

Future Growth

This role is expected to become part of a broader agency operations function. Over time, there may be opportunities to take on greater ownership of business operations, reporting, process improvement, sales operations, and other strategic initiatives as the team grows.

Position Overview

NTT DATA is seeking an accomplished executive leader to serve as Executive, Head of Cloud & Security within our Cloud & Security business. This role is responsible for defining and executing the global platform and innovation strategy that underpins the growth, scale, and differentiation of the Cloud & Security portfolio.

Reporting directly to the President, Cloud & Security, will lead the development, evolution, and operationalization of the OneNTT Platform, ensuring alignment with strategic business priorities while advancing engineering excellence, automation, cloud innovation, and AI-enabled capabilities across the organization. This executive will oversee a large, globally distributed organization and lead multiple critical capability areas including Platform Engineering, Automation, Generative AI, Cloud Strategy, Innovation, and Delivery Enablement. The role requires a visionary leader capable of driving transformational change, accelerating innovation, improving operational effectiveness, and enabling business growth through technology platforms and engineering excellence.

Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute the global strategy, vision, and roadmap for the OneNTT Platform and associated innovation capabilities.
  • Establish long-term platform, automation, AI, and cloud modernization strategies that support Cloud & Security business objectives.
  • Drive innovation programs that enhance service offerings, operational efficiency, and competitive differentiation.
  • Partner with Cloud & Security executive leadership to align platform investments with growth strategies and business priorities.

Platform & Engineering Excellence

  • Lead global Platform Engineering functions responsible for platform architecture, development, modernization, and lifecycle management.
  • Drive engineering productivity, standardization, automation, and operational excellence across Cloud & Security delivery organizations.
  • Champion adoption of modern engineering practices, cloud-native architectures, platform-based delivery models, and AI-driven automation.
  • Ensure platforms are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise technology standards.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

  • Lead innovation initiatives focused on Generative AI, automation, intelligent operations, and emerging cloud technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage new technologies to improve client outcomes, accelerate delivery, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Establish innovation frameworks that transform ideas into scalable, enterprise-ready solutions.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a globally distributed organization of more than 500 professionals.
  • Build and mentor a high-performing leadership team consisting of Executive Level leaders, Senior Directors, and Directors.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive workforce planning, leadership development, succession planning, and talent strategy across the function.

Business Enablement & Operational Performance

  • Establish operational metrics, governance frameworks, and performance management practices that drive accountability and measurable business outcomes.
  • Ensure platform and innovation investments deliver tangible value through productivity improvements, accelerated delivery, and enhanced customer experiences.
  • Collaborate with delivery, sales, solutioning, and business leaders to enable revenue growth and strategic business initiatives.

Executive Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives across NTT DATA.
  • Build strong partnerships with global business, technology, delivery, product, and operations leaders.
  • Influence enterprise decision-making through technology leadership, strategic insight, and execution excellence.
  • Represent Platform Technology & Innovation in executive forums and strategic planning discussions.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • Executive leadership experience leading large-scale global technology, platform engineering, cloud, or innovation organizations.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise platform strategies that drive business transformation and operational scale.
  • Deep expertise in one or more areas including Cloud Strategy, Platform Engineering, Automation, AI/Generative AI, Digital Engineering, or Technology Innovation.
  • Proven experience leading large, globally distributed teams through complex transformation initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic outcomes across global organizations.
  • Experience managing senior leadership teams, including executive-level leaders and directors.
  • Demonstrated financial, operational, and organizational leadership capabilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field. Advanced degree preferred.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking and Vision
  • Executive Influence and Stakeholder Management
  • Innovation and Transformation Leadership
  • Operational Excellence
  • Talent Development and Organizational Leadership
  • Change Leadership
  • Customer and Business Focus
  • Results Orientation

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. Step into a role where your client service expertise makes a meaningful impact. We are looking to add a Liability Claims Specialist to join our Creative Risk Solutions team. At CRS, we believe in doing things differently—empowering our team to deliver exceptional service, embrace creativity, and make a real impact for our clients.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Review coverage for commercial auto and general liability claims.
  • Adjudicate claims, investigate bodily injury/liability claims, and negotiate settlements using "Best Practices for Claims."

Role Summary

Pfizer Commercial Oncology is introducing the world to the next era of cancer care. With a growing portfolio of novel therapies, industry-leading R&D, and a goal of delivering eight breakthroughs by 2030 across major cancer types, we're translating cutting-edge science into market-shaping impact. Here, you'll partner with exceptional colleagues across scientific, medical, and manufacturing teams, backed by advanced digital and AI-enabled infrastructure and the authority to accelerate medicines from discovery to delivery. Guided by our values of courage, excellence, equity, and joy, you'll have the opportunity to stretch your skills and build a career that evolves with you—across teams, roles, and the Pfizer enterprise. Join us to make history — for patients, for their families, for the future.

The Senior Oncology Account Specialist (SOAS) will have a variety of responsibilities, ranging from promoting Pfizer’s product portfolio to health care providers and specialists, to educating members of the healthcare community regarding the appropriate use of Pfizer products, to calling on accounts and organized customers to help improve patients’ experience with Pfizer products, as well as the overall quality of patient care delivered.

The SOAS plays a critical role in increasing Pfizer’s brand with high-value target customers by linking an insightful assessment of the account and/or business landscape with a strong understanding of Pfizer’s products and resources.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • BA/BS Degree from an accredited institution BA/BS Degree from an accredited institution OR an associate’s degree with 8+ years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) with 10+ years of relevant experience.

  • Ability to travel domestically and stay overnight as necessary

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired

  • Minimum of 4 years of previous Pharmaceutical Sales experience or minimum of 4 years of previous Oncology Healthcare Professional (HCP) experience working with key Oncology thought leaders or high influence customers in hospitals, large group practices or managed care organizations.

  • A demonstrated track record of success and accomplishment with previous Pharmaceutical Sales experience or Healthcare Professional (HCP) experience

  • Exceptional aptitude for learning and ability to communicate technical and scientific product and disease management information to a wide range of customers

  • Demonstrated high degree of business acumen

  • Proficiency using complex digital applications and able to adapt to Pfizer’s long-range technology model in bringing relevant Pfizer information to market.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3-5 years of Oncology sales experience

  • Experience in Breast Cancer Therapeutic Areas

  • Master’s Degree

  • Advanced Healthcare Professional (HCP) Degree

  • Experience calling on institutions, NCI centers and Key Opinion Leaders

Functional / Technical Skills can include:

  • Promote broad portfolio of products; Strong knowledge of disease states, therapeutic areas, and products

  • Deep knowledge of applicable customers and markets (prescribers/HCPs/institutions/ organizations)

  • Generate demand for Pfizer products in assigned accounts

  • Strategic account selling and management skills.  Develop comprehensive territory/account/customer plans to drive achievement of desired objectives.

  • Maintain relationships throughout institutions

  • Overcome obstacles to gain access to difficult to see health care providers and customers.

  • Cultivate relationships with KOLs; build lasting relationships with top priority customers

  • Assess needs of target physicians/accounts; Address needs with responsive approach, targeted skills, and appropriate resources

  • Superior selling, technical and relationship building skills

  • Demonstrated ability to engage, influence and support customers throughout the selling process; excellent communication and interpersonal and leadership skills. 

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and embrace new ways of working in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Possess the ability to work in a matrix environment and to leverage multiple resources to meet customer needs and deliver results.

Other Job Details

Last Day to Apply: September 9th 2026

Territory includes but not limited to: Sacramento and Northern California

Relocation might be offered

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $108,600 - $250,700. During initial new hire sales training, you will be classified as a salary non-exempt employee which entitles you to overtime pay. Upon your training certification, you will become an overtime exempt employee. In addition, this position offers an additional Sales Incentive bonus. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits| (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. raw.description:
Why Tosca?

At Tosca, we’re redefining supply chains by delivering innovative solutions that drive sustainability, efficiency, and performance. As a leader in reusable packaging, we thrive on collaboration, transparency, and doing the right thing. Here, your work will matter. You’ll lead change, drive impact, and shape the future of how products move through global supply chains. Join a team where your voice is heard, your ideas have power, and your career can grow.

What You'll Do:

As the Director of Sales – Protein, you will lead the commercial strategy and execution for Tosca’s protein supply chain across North America, spanning beef, pork, poultry, and seafood. You’ll oversee a high-performing sales team responsible for managing and growing existing customer relationships while identifying and securing new business across both upstream (processors/plants) and downstream (retail) markets.
This role is critical to expanding the adoption of Tosca’s reusable packaging solutions—RPCs, bins, and pallets—by delivering value through supply chain innovation, sustainability, and strategic partnerships. You'll shape market strategy, drive execution, and unlock growth opportunities that align with Tosca’s mission to build smarter, more sustainable supply chains.
Responsibilities:
  • Lead the North American protein sales team, including strategy development, growth initiatives, pipeline management, customer relationship management, and budget oversight.
  • Develop and execute downstream (retail-focused) strategies to grow Tosca’s presence in protein categories.
  • Develop and execute upstream strategies across protein processing plants to drive adoption of Tosca’s reusable packaging solutions.
  • Identify, engage, and secure new retail customers; lead cross-functional collaboration with supply chain, logistics, warehousing, sustainability, procurement, and technology teams.
  • Strengthen and expand relationships with existing retail and processing partners.
  • Maintain and grow a pipeline of strategic sales opportunities across protein supply chains.
  • Conduct regular customer visits—both independently and alongside your team—to build relationships, understand customer needs, and ensure alignment of Tosca’s solutions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to uncover customer challenges and develop innovative packaging solutions that drive value.
  • Contribute to the development of new solutions and service offerings that improve supply chain efficiency and sustainability.
  • Actively support RPC conversions and trials at the retail level.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and professional development to direct reports within the sales team.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in a complex, solution-oriented environment.
  • Proven experience in protein industry sales (beef, pork, poultry, seafood), with a strong understanding of both retail and processor environments.
  • Demonstrated success in leading commercial teams, developing strategy, and managing complex customer relationships.
  • Background in supply chain, packaging, or sustainability solutions preferred.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, develop, and inspire high-performing teams.
  • Ability to personally conduct high-value sales: open, nurture, and close strategic customer relationships.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with customers and support team activities (overnight stays may be required).

Work Schedule

This is a remote position open to candidates located in the United States. The role requires frequent travel—up to 60% (approx. 15-18 days per month)—across North America to visit customers, service centers, attend industry events, and support your team in the field. Overnight travel should be expected on a regular basis.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Tosca, we believe in fostering a workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to creating an inclusive and equitable environment where all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

E-Verify Employer

Tosca participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information, please visit the E-Verify website.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Rockstar is hiring a full-time Payroll & Accounting Virtual Assistant on behalf of a therapist-owned physical therapy company operating across multiple affiliate organizations and states.

This role supports payroll processing and monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reconciliation across a group of distinct affiliate organizations. The ideal candidate is a fast learner who's comfortable operating within an established accounting system, keeps meticulous records, and can work independently once trained, while never cutting corners on accuracy or internal controls.

About the Client

This organization is a group of therapist-owned, therapist-led physical therapy companies, built by physical therapists who believed there had to be a better way to grow a practice, with more support and opportunity and less bureaucracy and burnout. The group spans dozens of clinic locations across multiple states, giving clinicians the autonomy and culture of an independent practice combined with the technology, resources, and support of a larger organization.

Their approach centers on clear paths for growth, modern systems, and genuinely investing in their people, values that extend to how they build and support their internal teams as well.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Support

  • Assist in payroll processing for 19 distinct affiliate organizations across 6 states
  • Review timesheets and hours for accuracy prior to payroll submission
  • Support payroll setup for new hires and processing for terminations
  • Help track and apply payroll deductions, benefits contributions, and adjustments as directed
  • Respond to basic payroll-related questions from affiliate contacts under guidance

Financial Close & Reconciliation

  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reconciliation processes across affiliate organizations
  • Keep accurate records of incoming and outgoing payments to vendors and customers
  • Assist with reconciling accounts and identifying discrepancies for review
  • Help prepare supporting documentation for close processes and internal reviews

Accounts Payable & Receivable Support

  • Assist with processing vendor invoices and payment requests
  • Match invoices to purchase orders or approvals as required
  • Track outstanding payments and follow up as directed
  • Maintain organized records of vendor and customer transactions

Systems & Accounting Operations

  • Learn and operate within the organization's accounting software (NetSuite ERP)
  • Maintain accurate, organized documentation across multiple affiliate accounts
  • Support internal audits and reviews by providing requested records and documentation
  • Help identify opportunities to streamline recurring accounting or payroll tasks

Tools & Systems

  • NetSuite ERP
  • Microsoft Office

Requirements

  • Experience with NetSuite ERP is highly preferred
  • Strong multitasking ability
  • Genuine desire to learn and grow within the role
  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight after training
  • Discreet in handling sensitive employee information
  • Competent with Microsoft Office products
  • Comfortable learning new software as needed
  • Team player, willing to jump in and contribute wherever needed
  • Comfortable presenting and interacting with peers

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This is a float position supporting all research clinics in the state of Florida.

  • Responsible for the performance of the research study under the medical supervision of the Principal Investigator and the research director.

  • The research coordinator is responsible for the overall successful implementation and ongoing site management of the research studies.

  • May be responsible for providing coverage in clinics when research staff are out of the office; for precepting new research staff in clinics; for assisting with research projects assigned by the Senior Clinical Research Coordinator III.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Candidates must have a valid RN license, in state of employment,

  • a minimum of one-year oncology or clinical research experience;

  • or a minimum of five years of combined clinical oncology and clinical research experience.

  • Candidates must have effective communication skills,

  • be organized,

  • detail oriented,

  • strong patient advocates.

  • Candidates must be available to travel to investigators meetings.

  • Valid Driver’s License, in state of residency, for travel to clinics.

  • Must comply with the Company’s Driver Safety Operations and Motor Vehicle Records Check Pol

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. Job Title:

VP, Enterprise Solution Architect

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

Concentrix is the global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our gamechangers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Vice President, Enterprise Solution Architecture

Contact Center Technologies | CRM | CCaaS | AI Automation | Interaction Analytics

Preferred Location: Eastern Time Zone

Concentrix is seeking a visionary Vice President, Enterprise Solution Architecture, to lead strategic solution architecture, innovation, and transformation initiatives within our Global Presales and Solutions organization. This executive-level leader will be responsible for defining and executing the enterprise technology vision across Customer Experience (CX) solutions while driving growth, innovation, and competitive differentiation.

The Vice President will lead a team of enterprise architects and solution consultants while serving as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, strategic partners, and Fortune 500 clients. This role will oversee the development of next-generation customer experience solutions spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), CRM, AI-powered automation, analytics, cloud platforms, and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, executive leadership, commercial acumen, and market vision with a proven ability to influence complex enterprise transformations. This individual will play a critical role in shaping solution strategy, accelerating revenue growth, strengthening hyperscaler and technology partnerships, and advancing the company's leadership position within the customer experience marketplace.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead and evolve the global Enterprise Solution Architecture function, establishing best practices, methodologies, governance frameworks, and solution standards.
  • Develop and execute the strategic technology vision for Customer Experience Services aligned with corporate growth objectives.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Enterprise Solution Architects, Solution Consultants, and Technology Specialists.
  • Serve as an executive advisor to internal leadership, clients, and strategic technology partners on emerging CX, AI, automation, and cloud technologies.
  • Drive innovation strategies that create market differentiation and support long-term business growth.

Solution Architecture & Presales Leadership

Provide executive oversight for all presales solutioning, enterprise architecture, and consulting engagements globally.

Lead the design and positioning of transformational CX solutions across:

  • Hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)
  • CCaaS Platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Microsoft Dynamics Contact Center)
  • CRM & Enterprise Platforms (Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Zendesk, SAP, Adobe)
  • AI & GenAI Solutions (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot)
  • Automation Platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate)
  • Service Management & Analytics (ServiceNow, Databricks, Snowflake, Power BI)
  • Establish scalable solution frameworks and architectural blueprints that accelerate sales cycles and improve delivery outcomes.
  • Guide complex strategic pursuits, large-scale RFPs, and executive-level solution presentations.

Revenue Growth & Business Development

Partner with Sales, Client Management, Delivery, and Product leaders to drive pipeline growth and revenue expansion.

Support strategic account planning, new logo acquisition, and cross-sell/up-sell initiatives.

  • Sponsor and lead executive solution workshops with enterprise clients to identify transformational opportunities.
  • Ensure solution strategies align with commercial objectives, profitability targets, and outcome-based pricing models.
  • Drive increased partner-sourced revenue and strategic alliance growth.

Executive Client & Partner Engagement

  • Develop executive relationships with Fortune 500 clients, technology partners, analysts, and industry influencers.
  • Serve as the senior technical executive during major customer pursuits and transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with hyperscaler and technology alliance executives to create joint go-to-market strategies and innovation roadmaps.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, client forums, analyst briefings, and partner events.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies impacting customer engagement, AI, automation, and digital transformation.
  • Establish AI governance and solution frameworks supporting responsible deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and automation technologies.
  • Drive development of repeatable accelerators, reference architectures, and intellectual property that enable growth and differentiation.
  • Champion innovation initiatives that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Annual Contract Value (ACV) influenced and closed
  • New logo acquisition and strategic account expansion
  • Win rate and solution conversion rate
  • Partner-sourced revenue growth
  • Strategic alliance growth and executive sponsorship
  • Enterprise solution pipeline generation
  • Team development, retention, and succession planning
  • Gross margin and solution profitability
  • Innovation and reusable solution asset creation
  • Customer satisfaction and executive stakeholder engagement

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, solution consulting, technology strategy, or presales leadership within enterprise technology, BPO, or customer experience services organizations.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing Enterprise Architects, Solution Consultants, or technical presales organizations.
  • Proven success leading large-scale solution architecture organizations supporting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 clients.
  • Deep expertise across Contact Center technologies, CRM platforms, cloud ecosystems, AI/GenAI solutions, automation, analytics, and customer experience transformation.
  • Demonstrated success driving multimillion-dollar technology pursuits, strategic accounts, and complex enterprise transformations.
  • Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, cognitive automation, predictive analytics, and customer engagement technologies.
  • Experience developing enterprise architecture standards, governance models, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience supporting outcome-based pricing, business case development, and investment justification.
  • Executive presence with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience establishing strategic partnerships with major technology providers and hyperscalers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within Customer Experience, Contact Center, BPO, Digital Transformation, or Technology Services industries.
  • Certifications across cloud, CCaaS, CRM, AI, and enterprise architecture platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Dynamics 365, ServiceNow, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, OpenAI, Anthropic, UiPath, and Databricks.
  • MBA, Master's Degree, or equivalent executive leadership experience.
  • Thought leadership experience through speaking engagements, industry publications, advisory boards, or analyst engagements.

Why This Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience transformation, lead industry-leading architecture and innovation teams, influence executive decision-makers globally, and drive growth through next-generation AI, automation, CCaaS, CRM, and analytics solutions. As a Senior Director, you will play a pivotal role in defining how organizations engage customers in an increasingly digital and AI-powered world.

The base salary for this position is $200,000 – $275,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is: 09/21/2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

If biometric identifiers or biometric information are collected, used, or stored, the Company will provide the legally required disclosures and obtain any required written consent prior to such collection, and will handle such information in accordance with applicable biometric privacy laws and Company policies.

Revenue Analyst

Colombia

Remote

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

We are looking for a Revenue Analyst to join our fast-growing Merchant Pricing & Analysis team. Reporting to our MP&A Billing Manager. This is a highly analytical role focused on large-scale portfolio pricing initiatives, mass pricing implementations, revenue optimization, and data validation. Success in this role requires advanced Excel skills, strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to work with large datasets to support pricing initiatives impacting thousands of merchants. This role does not support individual merchant pricing requests, customer service activities, account management, or call center operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enter, validate, and analyze pricing and fee structures to ensure accuracy and completeness
  • Calculate and support monthly manual billing processes, including data uploads
  • Analyze pricing strategies and recommend solutions to drive profitability and support revenue growth
  • Build, maintain, and QA billing configurations and pricing models
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and reporting variances
  • Assess the financial impact of billing changes, corrections, and new initiatives
  • Respond to escalations from Operations, Product, and Sales teams in a timely manner
  • Ensure compliance with SOX controls and internal policies
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements and automation
  • Support quarterly card brand enhancements and related pricing updates
  • Identify financial risks and communicate potential impacts
  • Take ownership of monthly billing activities, including issue identification, impact analysis, and process updates
  • Provide ad hoc analysis and support to the Merchant Pricing & Analysis team as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of related experience in billing, pricing, finance, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy in data entry, validation, and financial calculations
  • Experience with data validation and identifying discrepancies in financial or billing data
  • Comfortable calculating and analyzing financial impacts of changes, issues, and updates
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency as a requirement
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and consistently meet tight deadlines
  • Self-starter with a high level of initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Strong sense of accountability for completing high-impact manual billing activities accurately and on time
  • Proven ability to take ownership of tasks from start to finish, including validation and issue resolution
  • Driven to learn, ask questions, and continuously improve processes and understanding of the business
  • Inquisitive mindset with the ability to identify issues, dig into root causes, and propose solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain findings and issues

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

raw.description:
About Us

LexisNexis Legal & Professional serves customers across the global legal market with leading information, analytics, and technology solutions. We support law firms, corporate legal departments, and government entities in advancing the rule of law and improving legal outcomes.

Our Legal Market business is focused on innovation, commercial growth, and delivering exceptional customer value. We are seeking an experienced Senior HR Manager / Senior Human Resources Business Partner to provide strategic and operational HR partnership to leaders and employees while supporting an evolving and diverse workforce.


About the Role

The Senior HR Manager / Senior Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, managers, and employees, providing practical and strategic HR guidance that supports business priorities, workforce effectiveness, employee engagement, and organizational performance.


This role will support a workforce consisting of both union-represented and non-union employees and requires demonstrated experience in labor and employee relations. The Senior HR Manager will advise leaders on complex employee matters, grievances, performance and conduct issues, organizational change, and the consistent application of company policies and collective bargaining agreements.


The role partners closely with specialized HR teams including Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience, Talent Development, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, Legal, and HR Operations to deliver integrated HR solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen with hands-on HR expertise and will be comfortable operating in a complex, fast-paced environment. The role requires sound judgment, strong negotiation and influencing capabilities, and the ability to build trusted relationships with business leaders, employees, union representatives, and HR stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Business Partnership

  • Partner with business leaders and managers to understand business priorities and translate them into practical people plans and HR solutions.
  • Provide coaching, consultation, and HR guidance to leaders and managers on workforce, talent, performance, organizational, and employee matters.
  • Use workforce data and HR insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and support informed business decision-making.
  • Support organizational changes, restructures, workforce initiatives, and business transformation efforts.
  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence to implement enterprise and regional programs while adapting solutions to meet local business and workforce needs.
  • Promote AI fluency and support adoption of AI-enabled ways of working across the workforce.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen workforce skills and capabilities in support of evolving business needs.

Labor & Employee Relations

  • Serve as a key HR partner for a workforce that includes both union-represented and non-union employees.
  • Provide day-to-day labor relations guidance and counsel to leaders and managers regarding interpretation and application of collective bargaining agreements, workplace policies, practices, and employment requirements.
  • Manage and support the grievance process, including investigating concerns, gathering and evaluating relevant information, advising management, preparing responses, and partnering with Employee Relations and Legal as appropriate.
  • Build and maintain productive working relationships with union representatives while balancing employee, business, and organizational needs.
  • Participate in and support labor negotiations, requiring demonstrated negotiation skills and the ability to prepare for and navigate complex labor discussions.
  • Support contract administration and the consistent application of collective bargaining agreement provisions.
  • Partner with leaders on employee relations matters involving performance, attendance, conduct, conflict resolution, workplace investigations, and policy interpretation.
  • Coach managers on effective employee relations practices and appropriate documentation.
  • Identify potential employee and labor relations risks and escalate significant compliance, litigation, or business risks to Employee Relations, Legal, or senior HR leadership as appropriate.
  • Promote fair, consistent, and compliant employment practices across union and non-union employee populations.

Organizational Effectiveness & Change Management

  • Support organizational design and workforce structure initiatives aligned with business priorities.
  • Advise and coach leaders through organizational change, restructures, workforce transitions, and evolving operating models.
  • Develop and implement change management approaches that support effective communication, employee understanding, and adoption.
  • Assess organizational and employee trends and recommend solutions that strengthen engagement, effectiveness, and performance.
  • Partner with leaders and HR colleagues to support a positive employee experience during periods of change.

Workforce Planning & Talent Strategy

  • Partner with leaders to assess current and future workforce requirements and identify talent and capability needs.
  • Support workforce planning activities to align staffing, skills, and organizational capabilities with business objectives.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring strategies and workforce needs.
  • Support talent reviews, succession planning, and development planning for key roles and employee populations.
  • Identify talent risks and opportunities and work with leaders to develop appropriate action plans.

Talent Management & Leadership Development

  • Facilitate and support performance management, talent review, and employee development processes.
  • Coach managers and leaders to strengthen leadership capability, team effectiveness, and employee performance.
  • Partner with Talent Development and other HR Centers of Excellence to implement programs that build critical workforce and leadership capabilities.
  • Advise leaders on performance improvement, employee development, retention, and career planning.
  • Support managers in addressing complex employee performance and conduct matters.

Engagement, Culture & Inclusion

  • Partner with leaders to foster a high-performance, inclusive, and engaging workplace aligned with company values.
  • Support employee engagement initiatives, including employee survey analysis and action planning.
  • Identify workforce trends and recommend actions to strengthen employee engagement, retention, and organizational health.
  • Partner with leaders and HR colleagues to promote inclusive talent and employment practices.
  • Support fair and consistent application of compensation and reward practices in partnership with Total Rewards.
  • Build trusted relationships across union and non-union employee populations and promote constructive employee-management relationships.

HR Programs, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement HR programs, policies, frameworks, and tools in alignment with business requirements and enterprise HR practices.
  • Ensure HR practices comply with applicable employment and labor requirements, company policies, and collective bargaining agreements.
  • Lead or contribute to HR projects and initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness and employee experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Partner effectively across HR, Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, and business teams to resolve complex workforce matters.
  • Maintain current knowledge of HR practices, employment and labor relations trends, and evolving HR technologies.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with significant experience operating as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager, or comparable role in a complex organization.
  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business, Organizational Development, Labor Relations, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting union-represented employees is required.
  • Demonstrated experience handling employee and labor relations matters, including grievances, investigations, performance, conduct, and workplace concerns.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience working effectively with union representatives and management.
  • Experience interpreting and administering collective bargaining agreements.
  • Experience participating in union/collective bargaining agreement negotiations is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to support both union and non-union employee populations.
  • Experience advising and coaching managers on complex HR and employee relations matters.
  • Demonstrated experience with organizational change, performance management, workforce planning, and talent management.
  • Strong understanding of employment practices, labor relations principles, and HR compliance requirements.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect people priorities to operational and business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use workforce data and insights to identify trends and recommend solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, build credibility, and establish trusted relationships across multiple levels of an organization.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage sensitive and confidential matters, and navigate complex employee situations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and HR initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and HR technology to improve effectiveness, productivity, and employee or manager experiences.
  • Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

raw.description:
As a Cyber Security Analyst II on the Blue Team, you will strengthen and defend RecargaPay's cloud and internal environments through proactive security controls, continuous monitoring, and hardening. You will drive vulnerability management, secure our AWS cloud footprint, operate endpoint defense and Zero Trust controls, and apply strong cryptographic practices to keep our systems resilient against evolving threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    • Monitor, harden, and continuously improve the security posture of AWS cloud environments (IAM, WAF, Security Hub, GuardDuty, network security groups, and related AWS security services).
    • Own and evolve the vulnerability management program end to end — scanning, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting across infrastructure and applications.
    • Operate and tune EDR platforms to detect, contain, and remediate endpoint threats.
    • Design and implement Zero Trust Architecture controls, including identity-based access, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege enforcement.
    • Apply cryptography best practices — encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and certificate lifecycle — across systems and services.

As a Client Solutions Partner, Oncology you will play a critical leadership role in shaping culture, developing talent, strengthening customer partnerships, and driving meaningful business results. This is an opportunity to help lead the evolution of one of the industry's most comprehensive oncology organizations while working alongside talented colleagues united by a common mission: delivering innovative solutions that expand access, improve care, and create a better future for the patients and communities we serve.

Together, we are building One Labcorp Oncology: a high-performing team committed to growth, customer success, operational excellence, and advancing cancer care through every interaction.

raw.description:
ICF seeks a Data and Quality Manager to support a nationwide legal services program serving Unaccompanied Alien Children (UAC) across the United States. Reporting to the Deputy Director of Operations, this position will lead the Data and Quality Team and oversee data collection, quality management, reporting, performance monitoring, compliance tracking, and continuous quality improvement (CQI) activities supporting the contract. The Data and Quality Manager serves as a key member of the project management team and collaborates closely with operations staff, legal service providers, technology teams, subcontractors, and federal stakeholders to ensure accurate, timely, and actionable data are available to support program oversight, contract compliance, and service delivery improvement.

The purpose of this project is to provide legal services for unaccompanied children from Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR) care and custody and to expand the legal community’s skills and capacity to provide immigration legal support.

The Data and Quality Manager will oversee implementation and ongoing administration of LegalPath, the project's centralized case management and reporting platform, and ensure compliance with federal reporting requirements, data quality standards, quality assurance processes, and performance management expectations. As part of this position, the manager will develop dashboards, reports, analyses, and performance monitoring tools that transform complex operational, service delivery, quality, and outcome data into actionable insights that support decision-making, improve program performance, and strengthen service quality nationwide.

Key Responsibilities

As a Data and Quality Manager, you will oversee a team responsible for data governance, reporting, quality assurance, quality control, and continuous improvement activities supporting a national network of legal service providers.

Areas of responsibility may include:

  • Lead contract data collection, reporting, data governance, quality management, and performance monitoring activities.
  • Develop and implement data standards, reporting protocols, documentation requirements, and performance measurement processes.
  • Support implementation of the project's Quality Management Plan, data governance policies, and performance reporting framework.
  • Manage data validation, quality assurance, quality control, audit activities, and data integrity monitoring.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), acceptable quality levels (AQLs), service timelines, contract deliverables, and compliance requirements.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of data management systems, dashboards, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Develop and maintain executive dashboards, Power BI reports, performance scorecards, and data visualizations that provide visibility into service delivery, compliance, staffing, and outcomes.
  • Collect, analyze, and report quantitative and qualitative data from surveys, interviews, focus groups, stakeholder feedback, and administrative data systems.
  • Conduct trend analyses, root cause analyses, performance assessments, and predictive analyses to support operational improvements and decision making.
  • Develop monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports for federal stakeholders and project leadership.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership and operational teams.
  • Lead Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities, including quality reviews, monitoring activities, corrective action plans, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Support federal performance reviews, audits, monitoring visits, quality assessments, and contract compliance efforts.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to support data integrations, API connections, workflow automation, data security, and reporting enhancements.
  • Coordinate with legal, operations, intake, psychosocial, language services, and pro bono teams to ensure complete, accurate, and timely reporting across program functions.
  • Supervise and mentor Data Reporting Lead and Quality Management Lead, Data Analysts, Reporting Specialists, and Quality Specialists.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to staff responsible for data reporting, performance monitoring, and quality management activities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Public Health, Social Sciences, Evaluation, Information Systems, Public Administration, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience managing data collection, performance measurement, quality management, monitoring, evaluation, reporting, or continuous improvement activities.

OR

  • Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Evaluation, Public Health, Social Sciences, Public Administration, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing dashboards, reports, and performance monitoring tools using Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale data collection and reporting systems.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing quality assurance, quality control, compliance monitoring, and continuous quality improvement processes.
  • Experience supervising technical staff and/or quality management staff.
  • Experience managing multiple reporting, compliance, and quality oversight activities simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting complex federal, state, or large-scale nonprofit programs.
  • Experience monitoring contractual performance metrics, service-level requirements, and corrective action plans within a federally funded program.

Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience supporting Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR), Administration for Children and Families (ACF), Department of Justice (DOJ), HHS, or other federal programs.
  • Experience supporting legal services, child welfare, refugee, immigrant, human services, health, or social service programs.
  • Experience developing and implementing Quality Management Plans, Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) frameworks, or performance management systems.
  • Experience with data governance, audit methodologies, compliance monitoring, and performance measurement systems.
  • Experience developing executive-level reports, dashboards, and presentations for federal clients.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, and Dataverse.
  • Experience conducting satisfaction surveys, qualitative analyses, stakeholder feedback reviews, and mixed-methods evaluations.
  • Knowledge of federal reporting requirements, privacy standards, records management, and data security practices.
  • Experience with API integrations, ETL processes, SQL, and cloud-based reporting environments.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Professional Skills

  • Strong leadership, supervision, and team management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead data, reporting, and quality management functions across complex, multi-site programs.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify operational risks and develop data-driven recommendations for improvement.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into concise, actionable information for executive and client audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience fostering a culture of accountability, quality, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, program leadership, service providers, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact for assistance.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. raw.title: Field Sales Engineer – Germany
raw.excerpt: The role, at a glance: Biamp, a leading manufacturer of professional electronics for use in the installed audio and video communications market, is currently recruiting a new Field Sales Engineer who will work with customers mostly based in Germany.
raw.description:
The role, at a glance:
Biamp, a leading manufacturer of professional electronics for use in the installed audio and video communications market, is currently recruiting a new Field Sales Engineer who will work with customers mostly based in Germany. This position is a primary source for pre-sales technical and design support for all Biamp’s products.
The mission of this technical sales position is to assist the channel sales team in achieving the company’s sales targets by educating end users, consultants, AV integrators and distributors on design and performance attributes of Biamp’s products and technology, in a pre-sale capacity. The goal is to ensure the client specifies the right Biamp system for their project and is certain of achieving the performance they expect. The Field Sales Engineer also provides training and coaching to the design and installation teams for the distributor or AV integrator, with the aim of completing projects more effectively and profitably. This position partners closely with Biamp account managers and members of the business development team, as well as with the technical support team, whilst maintaining a close relationship with the customer.

How you'll contibute:

  • The Field Sales Engineer will take a leadership role through the technology evaluation stage of the sales process with major projects and key clients, remaining available to assist during the development of system design.

  • Manage all elements of the technical communication between Biamp and end users, consultants, AV and control integrators and distributors up to the point where the product is ordered. This includes writing (or participating in writing) proposals, drafting design drawings, providing quotations and creating any technical documentation or guidance required during the pre-sale stage.

  • After being introduced into a project by the Sales or Account Manager, a Field Sales Engineer’s responsibility is to develop relationships with decision-makers and technical staff, becoming their technical resource and reference.

  • Provide demonstrations and training of the technological aspects of Biamp’s products and solutions in the field to system integrators, consultants, end-users and distributors on all aspects of Biamp’s equipment, its functions and its uses.

  • Drive the sales process through all phases requiring technical or design decisions. Fully explain to clients how a Biamp solution solves their issues. Help increase Biamp market share by providing world-class technical expertise on every project.

  • Participate in regional trade shows as necessary, meeting customers at the booth and delivering equipment demos or providing technical expertise.

  • Maintain an ethos of constant self-improvement on sales techniques and technical skills.

  • Work in conjunction with Biamp sales managers as the key technical advisor and product advocate.

  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

  • This position will be located in Germany or a neighboring country.

You'll also support with:

  • Maintaining and upgrading the experience center in our facility.

  • Providing input and guidance for the creation of operations manuals for new products.

  • Creating and proofreading content for Biamp’s online knowledgebase.

  • Reporting client feedback on technical matters to Biamp leadership. Identifying and reporting any areas that could be improved for increased customer satisfaction.

  • Other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

A successful candidate should have:

  • Comprehensive general technical audio, video and control knowledge.

  • Experience with programming and installing AV and control systems.

  • AV networking design experience with CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, ENS, CompTIA or other relevant IT industry qualifications is a big plus.

  • Good computer literacy skills, including working knowledge of the MS Office suite, Visio & CAD programs and EASE Focus / Address.

  • Experience interfacing with distributors, system integrators, consultants, and end-users in the professional audio-visual and control industry.

  • Strong technical presentation skills, and the ability to address a wide range of business and technical people, from company presidents to non-technical staff.

  • Ability to build long-term relationships with customers.

  • Ability to work as part of a team.

  • Experience with international travel.

  • Excellent written and verbal English & Germany skills. The ability to speak and write fluently in another European language (Dutch or French) is a big plus.

  • Relevant degree or professional qualifications are desirable.

The position requires the ability to travel often and at short notice in Germany as
well as occasional trips throughout Europe and Biamp’s headquarters in
Beaverton, Oregon. This position includes the payment of all travel and office
costs, including office equipment. The Field Sales Engineer reports to the Field
Sales Engineering Manager, Europe & Africa.

Work Environment:

  • Work from home with up to 75% of travel.

Who is Biamp?

We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space.

As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences.

About our company:

At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The Position

The Coordinator, Payroll Client Services is responsible for resolving customer payroll inquiries and supporting smooth payroll operations. The role focuses on learning payroll processes, mastering support workflows, and resolving standard client issues efficiently. Coordinators rely heavily on documentation and established escalation paths while developing foundational payroll expertise. Success at this level requires strong attention to detail, clear communication with customers, and the ability to follow structured operational processes. As Coordinators gain experience, they are expected to resolve a broader range of payroll inquiries independently and deepen their understanding of payroll systems and regulations.

Responsibilities

Client Issue Resolution

  • Resolve customer inquiries related to payroll processing, discrepancies, and platform usage.
  • Ensure timely responses via email, chat, phone, and other channels that meet service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Handle customer inquiries according to defined workflows and expectations, such as Remote values and Remote Customer Code.
  • Gather necessary information to diagnose payroll issues accurately using the available tools, documentation and customer information.
  • Escalate complex cases to senior team members following defined workflows.
  • Document issue details and resolution steps clearly.

Customer Communication

  • Provide timely updates to customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.
  • Clarify customer questions related to payroll processes or platform functionality in customer understandable terms.
  • Maintain professionalism and clarity in all written and verbal communication with customers.

Operational Process Execution

  • Follow internal workflows and support documentation to resolve cases consistently.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of support tickets and case outcomes.
  • Adhere to defined SLAs and operational guidelines.

Learning & Knowledge Development

  • Identify and bring up recurring issues or gaps in documentation or processes to help improve team efficiency.
  • Build foundational understanding of payroll concepts and processes.
  • Learn payroll rules and compliance considerations in supported regions.
  • Seek guidance from senior team members when encountering unfamiliar issues.

Practicals

  • Direct reports: No
  • Team: [Customer Experience] - [Payroll Client Services]
  • Location: APAC

Application process

  6. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

$19,650—$49,700 USD
